description.text:
Turn complex business needs into scalable analytics solutions that support better, data-driven decisions. As a Senior Data Analyst, you connect stakeholders with technical platforms and deliver high-quality solutions spanning data ingestion, modelling, reporting and visualization.  
  
About the job  
You translate business requirements into scalable data and reporting solutions, taking ownership of the complete analytics landscape and ensuring that it is maintainable, reusable and aligned with organizational standards.  
 
Job responsibilities 
Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into actionable analytics solutions.  
Design, develop and maintain Databricks data pipelines and transformations based on Medallion architecture.  
Build scalable Power BI and Tabular semantic models using star schema design and Kimball methodologies.  
Develop clear, user-focused Power BI reports and dashboards that provide actionable insights.  
Maintain data quality, integrity, security and performance throughout the analytics lifecycle.  
Promote standardization, reusability and continuous improvement across analytics solutions.  

 
Location 
This position is in Fagersta, Sweden.  
  
Your profile   
You’ve delivered end-to-end analytics solutions and combine strong technical expertise with a clear understanding of business needs. Comfortable working independently, you take solutions from initial requirements through implementation and reporting.  
 
Your background includes 
Proven experience with Databricks and Power BI. 
Strong expertise in data modelling, Kimball-based star schemas, DAX and report development.  
Hands-on experience developing data pipelines with Python, notebooks and SQL. 
A solid understanding of Medallion architecture and scalable data design. 
Experience translating business requirements into technical implementations. 
Experience with Tabular Editor 3, including advanced measure design, calculation groups and model 

 
Familiarity with the Scrum framework is an advantage.  
 
Analytical and structured, you approach challenges with curiosity and sound judgement. You communicate clearly, build proactive stakeholder relationships and share knowledge openly. An ownership mindset helps you stay accountable while balancing business priorities, governance and technical quality.  
  
Our Seco culture   
At Seco, we're united by a spirit of collaboration and a shared curiosity to learn and grow. We take responsibility for our actions, stay focused on our customers and believe in winning together. For us, it’s also clear that our diversity provides a strong foundation for achieving great results. Curious about our workplace and benefits? Read more on our website. You’re also welcome to visit our LinkedIn or Facebook to learn more about us and our products. 
   
Contact information   
For further information about this position, please contact Rodrigo David Rivas Rodriguez, hiring manager, rodrigo_david.rivas_rodriguez@secotools.com

How to apply 
Send us your application no later than November 1st, 2026. Click Apply and include your resume and cover letter in English. Please note that we don’t accept applications by email. Job ID: R0097907.

  • Develop clear, user-focused Power BI reports and dashboards that provide actionable insights.
  • Maintain data quality, integrity, security and performance throughout the analytics lifecycle.
  • Promote standardization, reusability and continuous improvement across analytics solutions.

Location

This position is in Fagersta, Sweden.

 

Your profile  

You’ve delivered end-to-end analytics solutions and combine strong technical expertise with a clear understanding of business needs. Comfortable working independently, you take solutions from initial requirements through implementation and reporting.

Your background includes

  • Proven experience with Databricks and Power BI.
  • Strong expertise in data modelling, Kimball-based star schemas, DAX and report development.
  • Hands-on experience developing data pipelines with Python, notebooks and SQL.
  • A solid understanding of Medallion architecture and scalable data design.
  • Experience translating business requirements into technical implementations.
  • Experience with Tabular Editor 3, including advanced measure design, calculation groups and model

Familiarity with the Scrum framework is an advantage.

Analytical and structured, you approach challenges with curiosity and sound judgement. You communicate clearly, build proactive stakeholder relationships and share knowledge openly. An ownership mindset helps you stay accountable while balancing business priorities, governance and technical quality.

Job Description
As a Lead Data Analyst focused on Analytics engineering, you will play a key role in raising the analytical and technical maturity of our Data Analysts by establishing standards, providing hands-on guidance and enabling analysts to build robust and scalable data products.  
You will lead the development and adoption of Analytics Engineering practices across the organization, helping teams improve how data is modeled, governed, and consumed. Through upskilling, knowledge sharing, and creation of reusable frameworks and assets, you will strengthen our analytics capabilities and help establish a more consistent way of working with data.  
The role requires a high degree of autonomy, initiative taking, and collaboration. You will proactively identify opportunities to improve data practices, drive cross-functional initiatives, and build alignment across diverse stakeholder groups. Success in this role depends on your ability to balance strategic priorities with execution, navigate a complex organization and data landscape, and help teams deliver analytical solutions that are scalable, maintainable and aligned with business needs.  


WHAT YOU'LL DO
Lead complex analytical initiatives end-to-end, from problem framing and data exploration to data modeling, analysis and actionable recommendations. 
Partner with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to translate strategic questions and business needs into analytical approaches, scalable data models, and actionable insights. 
Lead the development of reusable data assets, templates, and frameworks that streamline work and promote scalability. 
Champion best practices in Analytics Engineering through the data analytics community, including data modeling, testing, documentation and maintainability of analytical data products, ensuring the support both traditional analytics and emerging AI driven use cases. 
Own and drive the Analytics Engineering community for Data Analysts, establishing standards and fostering collaboration across the organization.  
Design and deliver training sessions, workshops, and documentation to upskill colleagues in tools, methodologies, and data interpretation. 
Proactively identify and act on opportunities to improve data literacy and analytical capabilities across the organization. 
Mentor colleagues and contribute to a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. 



WHO YOU ARE 
We are looking for people with...
Proven experience leading complex analytical initiatives and influencing analytical direction across teams or domains. 
Strong business understanding and ability to translate complex or ambiguous business needs into clear analytical questions, approaches, and recommendations. 
Experience driving standards, best practices, and ways of working across teams through influence, coaching, and collaboration. 
Proven experience mentoring and developing colleagues through coaching, training, and knowledge sharing. 
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain complex analytical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. 
High proficiency in SQL and strong understanding of data modeling principles. 
Experience developing and maintaining analytical data products using tools such as dbt, Power Query, or similar. 
Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts and modern analytics architectures. 
Experience with version control (Git) and CI/CD practices within analytics workflows. 
Experience using Python, R, or similar technologies to support analytical workflows and automation. 
Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. 



WHO WE ARE 
H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. 
We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. 


WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE 
At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. 
We offer all our employee’s attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a 25% staff discount usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here. 
30 days holiday 
We offer a collective agreement which includes pension and life insurance
H&M Incentive Program
Wellness benefit 4000kr/year
Benifex Benefits Portal
Community with activities 



JOIN US 
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things, our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are. 
Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here. 
*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

Data Business Analyst – Analytics Solution for Product, Installed-Base and Commercial Data
About the role
 Our client is looking for a Data Business Analyst to help build and scale an analytics solution that brings together product, installed-base and commercial data. The role is hands-on and sits between the business and the technical data teams.
Responsibilities
Turn business rules and use cases into clear data requirements
Map required data attributes to their source systems
Evaluate how available, complete, accurate and reliable the data is
Identify data gaps and coordinate corrections and enrichment together with Business, Product Management, Master Data Management and Analytics/BI
Validate data before it is implemented in BI
Support sustainable data governance, including ownership, definitions and quality standards
Deliver documented requirements, data mappings, gap assessments and prioritized improvement actions

Required skills and experience
Several years of experience as a Data Business Analyst, Data Analyst or in a comparable role, converting business needs into data requirements
Practical experience with data profiling and analysis using tools such as SQL and Excel/Power Query
Experience with master data, product data and data quality in PIM/MDM environments
Solid understanding of data governance, including ownership, definitions, quality rules and stewardship
Strong stakeholder management and coordination skills across business and IT functions
Excellent documentation skills and fluency in spoken and written English

Meritorious skills
Experience with STEP (Stibo Systems)
Experience with Snowflake or Databricks
Background in the aftermarket or parts and accessories space, such as product compatibility, installed base or spare parts
Experience working with BI/Power BI teams, analytics or recommendation models
Ability to start at short notice

description.text:
Vill du arbeta med tekno-ekonomisk modellering och finansiell analys i hjärtat av den gröna omställningen? Åt vår kund som ett ledande nordiskt energibolag, söker vi nu en Business Analyst till deras kontor i Solna. I denna roll får du en nyckelposition där dina analyser direkt påverkar storskaliga investeringsbeslut och industriella energilösningar. Kanske är du i början av din karriär och vill ta nästa kliv Tjänsten erbjuder stor påverkan, en hög grad av flexibilitet samt ett nära samarbete med ett erfaret och sammansvetsat analysteam. Ansök idag då urval sker löpande! 
Om tjänsten
Vi söker en Solution Analyst som blir länken mellan finans, teknik och affärsutveckling för att stötta vår kunds tillväxt på den svenska energimarknaden. Du utvärderar tekno-kommersiella koncept ur ett finansiellt perspektiv och tar fram besluts- och affärsunderlag för komplexa energiprojekt. Genom att omvandla kvantitativ data och energisystemmodellering till tydliga affärsinsikter skapar du presentations- och säljmaterial som visar den finansiella bärkraften för kunder och beslutsfattare. Rollen passar dig som vill fördjupa dig i tekno-ekonomisk modellering och trivs med frihet under ansvar. Du ingår i ett gränsöverskridande analysteam med kollegor i Solna och Finland, samt samarbetar nära lokala team inom projektutveckling och försäljning. Tjänsten utgår från kontoret i Solna, erbjuder en flexibel hybridmodell och innebär resor till Finland ungefär en gång i månaden. 
Arbetsuppgifter
Genomföra energisystem- och finansiell kalkylering/modellering för industriella energiprojekt i olika beslutsfaser.
Bearbeta och analysera stora datamängder i avancerade Excel-modeller för att generera affärsnyttiga beslutsunderlag.
Bereda, samordna och sammanställa interna business cases samt investeringsförslag (inklusive CAPEX- och kassaflödesberäkningar).
Skapa och förbereda värdebaserat försäljnings- och presentationsmaterial (value selling) grundat på kvantitativa underlag för kunder och intressenter.
Delta i kundmöten och agera teknisk/finansiell tolkningslänk gentemot kommersiella och tekniska intressenter.

Vi söker dig som
Har en avslutad akademisk utbildning inom industriell ekonomi, nationalekonomi eller motsvarande ekonomisk/teknisk inriktning.
Har 1–3 års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet inom finansiell analys, business analysis eller teknisk-ekonomisk rådgivning (gärna från energisektorn, B2B-consulting eller corporate finance).
Har praktisk erfarenhet av modellering och avancerad analys i Excel samt vana vid att hantera stora datamängder.
Har flytande kunskaper i både svenska och engelska i tal och skrift, då båda språken används dagligen i kommunikationen med interna och externa intressenter.
CV på engelska

Det är meriterande om du:
Har god förståelse för grundläggande finansiella beräkningar, kassaflödesmodeller och investeringskalkylering (t.ex. CAPEX, NPV).
Har kunskaper inom Python

För att lyckas är du en analytisk och strukturerad problemlösare som trivs med komplex data och omvandlar den till tydliga beslutsunderlag. Du har stark kommunikativ förmåga och pedagogisk känsla för att förklara tekniska och finansiella detaljer för olika intressenter. Du har ett stort intresse för energibranschen, drivs av nyfikenhet på nya affärsmodeller och arbetar självständigt med ett starkt självledarskap i internationella, tvärfunktionella samarbeten.
Vår rekryteringsprocess
Denna rekryteringsprocess hanteras av Academic Work och vår kunds önskemål är att alla frågor rörande tjänsten skickas till Academic Work.
Vi tillämpar löpande urval och kommer plocka ner annonsen när tillräckligt många kandidater har nått slutskedet i rekryteringsprocessen. Vid ansökan efterfrågas ett CV. Personligt brev använder vi inte som urvalsmetod och behöver därför inte bifogas. Rekryteringsprocessen innehåller två urvalstest: ett personlighetstest och ett test i kognitiv förmåga. Testerna är ett verktyg för att kunna hitta den kandidat med högst potential för tjänsten samt främja jämlikhet, mångfald och en rättvis rekryteringsprocess.

description.text:
Nordnet is redefining the landscape of savings and investments, guiding over 2.5 million customers in their financial lives. We have spent the last years building a modern data platform and fostering a culture where actionable insights and rapid product refinement are part of our DNA. In our fast-paced environment, this remains a competitive edge - allowing us to ship, learn, and iterate faster than the market.
Now we are seeking to engage a passionate Data Analyst to join our team.
The role
As a Data Analyst at Nordnet, you will be a part of Data & Insights, where you have the opportunity to work alongside Data analysts, Data Scientists, Analytics Engineers and Data Engineers.
You will be embedded in our Product development teams, where you will be an integral component, working with designers, product leads and developers. You will deep-dive into our users and our products, and turn data into actionable insights.
We would love it if you feel excited about at least some of these statements.

Going beyond simple questions, defining a problem and understanding the right analytical approach


Conduct statistical analyses on our customer -, financial -, and company data to identify patterns of behaviour


Design experiments to evaluate various hypotheses and design choices


Utilize AI and advanced modeling to scale your impact


Craft and present compelling stories that will impact our decision makers


Help improve our existing methodologies

This is you
You are passionate about data and learning new things, and you want to contribute with your experience and ideas. In your work, you are organised, methodical and agile in a way that benefits the team’s working climate and ability to deliver solutions.
To thrive in this role, we believe that most of these criteria describe you:

Proactive, with a strong sense of ownership


A strong communicator with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders


Experience of using SQL, Python, R and dbt


Hands-on experience with A/B testing


Degree in economics, data science, statistics, engineering, mathematics, or similar


 We think that you have 3+ years experience working as a Data Analyst at a product oriented organisation.
What we offer
We are committed to your continuous growth, offering a space where you can learn, contribute, and take ownership of your technical domain over time. At Nordnet, we offer:

A hybrid work model balancing remote flexibility with collaboration in our Stockholm office.


5,000 SEK annual wellness contribution (friskvårdsbidrag).


A culture that values continuous learning and technical ownership.


Visit us on www.nordnetab.com,www.nordnet.se, www.nordnet.no, www.nordnet.dk and www.nordnet.fi.
Application
At Nordnet, we know that the best products are built by teams with a mix of different backgrounds and perspectives. If you are excited about the challenges we’re solving and see yourself contributing to our team culture, we’d love to hear from you.
To ensure a fair and streamlined process for everyone, we only accept applications through our recruitment system. We interview continuously, so feel free to reach out as soon as possible!
Please note: Nordnet conducts credit and background checks as well as a drug test on the final candidate as part of our standard process for a digital bank.
We look forward to meeting you!

The World Maritime University (WMU) was founded in 1983 within the framework of the International Maritime Organization (IMO), a specialized agency of the United Nations, as its premier centre of excellence for maritime postgraduate education, research and capability development. The University offers unique postgraduate programmes, conducts wide-ranging research in maritime and ocean-related studies, and advances maritime capability development in line with the UN Sustainable Development Goals.
The WMU–Lloyd's Register Foundation Maritime Observatory is a new strategic initiative established to strengthen the availability, analysis and use of high-quality evidence in support of maritime policy and decision-making. The Observatory will combine data analytics, evidence synthesis and policy-relevant research to generate insights on important and emerging maritime issues.
The Data Analyst will support the establishment and operation of the WMU-LRF Maritime Observatory across the full analytical cycle: identification, acquisition, management, analysis and visualization of maritime data and the development of evidence-based knowledge products such as dashboards, models, reports and briefs.
The incumbent will report to the Head of Data and Insights (WMU-LRF Maritime Observatory) and work closely with other members of the Observatory team to develop its data and analytical capabilities. The position requires a combination of technical data skills, analytical curiosity and an interest in applying data and evidence to maritime policy questions.
This is an opportunity to join a strategic initiative, the Observatory, at its founding stage. The successful candidate will have an opportunity to contribute directly to the development of its data infrastructure, analytical methods, AI workflows and knowledge products. It is an opportunity to shape how the Observatory works from the outset, and contribute to its work supporting international maritime policy-making.
WMU offers an attractive remuneration package including a tax-free annual net base salary starting at the applicable P1 level (subject to mandatory deductions for pension contributions and health insurance), with a variable post adjustment, dependency benefits, education grant, relocation and repatriation expenses, as applicable under the relevant rules.
Candidates will be contacted if they are short-listed.
This vacancy is open to eligible candidates that satisfy the education, experience and language criteria noted above.
WMU is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment of mutual respect. WMU recruits and employs staff regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, religious, cultural and ethnic backgrounds or disabilities.
Application
Applicants must apply online through the University’s website

description.text:
Do you want to use data, analytics and technology to improve supply chain performance in an international organization?

Lindab is looking for a Strategic Supply Chain Developer to join our Group Strategic Supply Chain team. The role combines inventory management with group-wide supply chain analytics and development, offering the opportunity to work with both operational improvements and strategic initiatives. You will report to the Strategic Supply Chain Manager and work closely with the Inventory Manager & Data Analyst. The role will be divided approximately equally between Inventory Management and Strategic Supply Chain Analytics and can be based in either Grevie or Malmö.

About the role

As a Strategic Supply Chain Developer, you will transform data into reliable analytical and operational solutions, actionable insights and recommendations that support better business decisions. You will work with information from different companies, business systems and supply chain functions, covering areas such as inventory, sourcing, manufacturing, warehousing, transportation and distribution.

Within Strategic Supply Chain Analytics, you will contribute to group-wide analyses of Lindab's supply chain footprint and product flows. This includes understanding where products are purchased, produced, stored and sold, identifying opportunities for improvement and support in implementation of these opportunities. You will collaborate with stakeholders across Supply Chain, Operations, Purchasing, Sales and IT.

Within Inventory Management, you will analyse performance and support Lindab companies in developing their processes, systems and ways of working. Together with the Inventory Manager, you will examine stock levels, availability, demand patterns, planning parameters and replenishment settings. You will also contribute to initiatives aimed at reducing tied-up capital while maintaining appropriate availability and service levels.

A central part of the role is developing analytical solutions and supportive tools for Lindab from underlying business and ERP data. You will work across the full process, from collecting, validating and structuring data to creating data and semantic models, defining business logic and developing clear reports and decision-support tools. You will also contribute to data-quality improvements, master-data development, documentation and the automation of recurring analytical activities.

Who we are looking for

We welcome candidates with strong analytical and technical capabilities and a solid understanding of supply chain, business intelligence, inventory management, logistics, or data development. You have a master’s degree in supply chain management, Logistics, Industrial Engineering, Business Analytics, Data Science or equivalent in a related field.

You have strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills and are interested in how data, systems, processes and business decisions interact. You understand the principles of databases, data modelling, semantic models and business intelligence and have the ability to present complex findings in a clear and practical way. Experience in developing analytical solutions, working with ERP data or using programming and automation tools is a merit. Strong communication skills in both Swedish and English are required.

To succeed in this role

You are curious, structured and motivated by solving business problems through data and technology. You are comfortable developing complete solutions rather than only creating reports from existing models. You can move between technical development and supply chain analysis, take ownership of your work and translate complex data into practical recommendations. Comfortable working independently when needed while collaborating effectively across functions, companies, and countries. The role requires flexibility to work from both Grevie and Malmö as needed, based on business priorities and meeting requirements.

What Lindab offers

You will join Lindab's Group Strategic Supply Chain department, a central team working across companies, regions and functions throughout the organization. The department combines specialist expertise in sourcing, transportation, inventory and warehouse management. Its work includes group-wide projects, supply chain concepts and shared services, as well as the development and improvement of common processes, systems and analytical solutions.

We provide structured onboarding and education covering Lindab's organization, supply chain processes, analytical methods and ways of working. You will learn from experienced colleagues and specialists while gradually taking greater ownership of solutions, improvement initiatives and cross-company projects. This provides strong opportunities to broaden your supply chain knowledge, develop your technical capabilities and build an international network across Lindab.

Learn more about us at www.lindab.com.

Additional Information

For questions regarding the position or the recruitment process, please contact:

Dag Jarlson - Strategic Supply Chain Manager, dag.jarlson@lindab.com, +46431-850 88

Selection and interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.

Start date: By agreement

Employment type: Full-time, permanent position

Location: Grevie or Malmö, Sweden

Lindab Group is a leading ventilation group in Europe, consisting of companies that develop, manufacture, market and distribute products and systems for energy-efficient ventilation and a healthy indoor climate. We aim to be the most attractive workplace in the industry, built on responsible values regarding sustainability, innovation, and diversity.

description.text:
About Acast
Since 2014, Acast has been building the world’s most valuable podcast marketplace, creating the technology that connects podcast creators, advertisers, and listeners. Its marketplace spans more than 140,000 podcasts, 3,300 advertisers, and one billion quarterly listens. Crucially, those listens are monetized wherever they happen—across any podcast app or listening platform.


About the role
We're looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our BI team as the trusted data partner for Finance, Product, Sales, and Content Managers who work day-to-day with our podcasters. This role puts you at the forefront of agentic analytics, building the foundation that empowers AI agents to help stakeholders directly query and navigate complex data on their own. Spanning full-stack data work from raw data to consumption-ready dashboards, the position is as much about people and clear context as it is about data, so you'll spend as much time listening, clarifying, and building trust as you will building models.
The best person for this role is someone who genuinely enjoys sitting with a stakeholder's half-formed question, working out what they're really asking, and bringing back an answer that makes their decision easier. You'll care as much about how something lands with the person asking as about whether the number is right.


What you'll do
Be the first person Finance, Product, Sales, and Content Managers turn to when they have a data question they can't quite put into words yet, and help them find the words.
Own and evolve our core reporting infrastructure and data models in dbt and Omni across podcast consumption, listens, views, revenue, payout, and product analytics metrics - structuring underlying business logic so AI agents in Omni can reliably answer stakeholder questions in real time.
Build and maintain dashboards that people actually understand and want to use, not just ones that are technically correct.
Notice patterns and risks in payout, platform, and podcast consumption metrics before they become someone else's problem, and flag them early and clearly.
Support Content Managers and Product teams with the data behind podcast consumption analysis, covering listens and views metrics as well as performance trends and payout questions, and help Sales understand what the numbers mean for their conversations with advertisers.
Support teammates by explaining your thinking, documenting decisions, and making it easy for others to pick up where you left off.
Collaborate closely with Analytics Engineers, Data Engineers, developers, and Product Managers to ensure consistency across data models, metrics, and definitions.



Who you are
Someone who listens well and asks good follow-up questions before jumping to a solution.
Strong SQL and dbt skills, proficiency in BI tools like Omni, and experience accelerating analytics development using AI tools such as Cursor or Claude.
A steady, careful approach to data that people can rely on — especially where finance and payouts are involved.
Comfort holding several relationships at once — Finance, Product, Sales, and Content — without losing warmth or clarity under pressure.
A collaborative, generous way of working: sharing context, mentoring where helpful, and making the people around you better at their jobs too.
Proven ability to translate complex business logic into robust, maintainable data models and clear metrics definitions.



Culture 
Acast is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, national origin or any of the other wonderful characteristics that make us different.
Culture is our number one priority as a business. We believe people come first, and we work every day to enable autonomy, continuous improvement and bring out the best in people. We’re global and have remote teams, so it’s even more important that we strive for an open, inclusive and caring environment where everyone feels visible and welcome. 
We consider ourselves a modern organization driven by strong values to create the best, most fulfilling and nurturing culture.
We very much look forward to finding the next great person to join our cause!

description.text:
About Hotmat.se
Hotmat.se is a growing Swedish food delivery company that partners with restaurants across Sweden. We develop and maintain our own digital platforms and are looking for a Data Analyst to help us understand our business better and make smarter, faster decisions.


Job Description
As a Data Analyst at Hotmat.se, you will be responsible for turning our order, delivery, and customer data into clear insights that support the business. You will work closely with our leadership and development team to build reporting that helps us track performance, spot problems early, and grow more efficiently.


Responsibilities
Analyze order, delivery, and customer data to identify trends and issues
Clean, structure, and prepare data from multiple sources (orders, deliveries, payments, customer feedback) to ensure quality and consistency
Build and maintain dashboards and reports using visualization tools
Write and optimize SQL queries to extract data from our databases
Use Python and pandas for deeper analysis on larger datasets
Present findings in a clear, actionable way to non-technical stakeholders
Collaborate with the development team on data collection and quality


Required Skills
SQL
Python and pandas
Excel
Data cleaning and preparation
Data visualization tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau, or similar)


Who We Are Looking For
We are looking for someone who is:


Passionate about data and turning numbers into decisions
Self-motivated and proactive
Detail-oriented and quality-focused
A strong problem solver
Able to work independently as well as part of a team


What We Offer
Opportunity to shape how a growing company uses data, from the ground up
A growing and innovative company
Flexible working environment
Exciting technical challenges


Location
Gothenburg office


Employment Type
Full-time, permanent position with an initial probationary period.


How to Apply
Please send your CV and, if available, examples of past analysis or dashboards, to jobb@hotmat.se

description.text:
Analytics Engineer
Stockholm or Munich | Full-time 
The Role:
As an Analytics Engineer, you’ll help shape how data is structured, accessed, and used across the business. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to build reliable, scalable data solutions that support smarter decisions.
As a vital member of our international IT organization, you will be involved in the foundation of our internal product development and will join the cross-functional data team that is responsible for developing and maintaining Netlight's business-critical data platform and strives to decentralize analytics. That is why it is important that you are a self-driven person, who is comfortable with taking initiative and responsibility, as well as a service-minded and communicative team player.


Who you are:
A trusted communicator who builds relationships across technical and non-technical stakeholders and translates data into decisions.
Self-driven and proactive, but also team-oriented, with sound judgment on when to lean on AI tools for speed and when human oversight and design thinking matter more.
Comfortable working in ambiguity — organized yet flexible, able to adapt as tools, priorities, and team structures evolve quickly.
A curious, fast learner with a growth mindset — genuinely energized by new tools, AI-assisted workflows, and continuously raising your own technical bar.



Qualifications 
We are looking for someone with:
A degree in a quantitative field (e.g. software engineering, computer science, economics, mathematics, statistics) — if you think you’re a great fit, we want to hear from you!
At least 2+ years of relevant experience in fields like Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Analytics, Data Science, or Software Development.
Strong SQL skills, with hands-on experience building and testing data models in dbt on a cloud warehouse, and an understanding of dimensional data modeling (star schemas, facts and dimensions).
Solid grasp of version control with Git, including CI/CD workflows for data pipelines.
Familiarity with Python for data transformation, automation, and light pipeline work.
Fluency in written and spoken English (business level).
Comfort working with AI copilots and AI-assisted analytics tools (e.g. Copilot-style code/doc generation, AI BI assistants) while maintaining human oversight on data quality and design.



Nice to have:
Experience with, or strong interest in, semantic layers and metric governance — ensuring a single, trusted definition of key business metrics that both humans and AI tools can rely on.



What you will do:
You will join the cross-functional data team responsible for Netlight's data platform, enabling decentralized analytics across the organisation. Your key focus areas will be:
Data Modeling & Quality: Transform raw data into clean, usable datasets for analytics, business intelligence, and AI use cases. Collaborate with stakeholders to define and maintain a semantic layer and single source of truth for key business metrics. Ensure data quality and consistency across teams and tools, and build robust, well-documented data models using Snowflake and dbt.
Governance & Enablement: Provide compliant, user-friendly access to data across various tools (e.g. Power BI, Excel, or AI-powered BI assistants). Empower users of all technical levels — including AI agents — to find, understand, and securely query the data they need. Own the data access lifecycle end-to-end, balancing self-service efficiency with security, privacy, and compliance requirements. Maintain clear documentation and metadata (data catalog, definitions, lineage, ownership).
Optimization & Agile Delivery: Continuously evaluate and improve data models for performance and scalability. Contribute to agile ways of working, participating in planning, refinement, and delivery cycles. Stay current with emerging tools and practices in the data stack (e.g. orchestration, observability, AI-assisted development) and help the team adopt what is genuinely useful.



What we offer:
The possibility to be a core part of one of the most successful IT-consultancy companies in the industry
Professional development and long-term career progression through knowledge sharing, mentorship, feedback, coaching, and external training
Modern and centrally located offices in Stockholm or Munich
A culture centered around community, collaboration, and continuous learning, complemented by social and competence-building events
Everything you need to do your magic (computer, phone, mobile subscription)
Mental health & parental support offerings
30 days of paid vacation.



Specific benefit package if positioned in Stockholm:
5000 sek / year in health care benefit (“friskvård”)
Private pension savings

Specific benefit package if positioned in Munich:
Deutschlandticket
Wellpass



About us
Netlight is a global consulting company, turning complex needs into practical, real changes.


Come work with us
You will join a company built around personal responsibility, collaboration, and continuous learning. Different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives make that possible, and we welcome applicants of all identities.


Apply today
This is a full-time role based in Stockholm or Munich, with a start date as soon as possible. Please read the required qualifications carefully: fluency in English is essential.
Send us your current CV in English. Links to relevant projects, GitHub, or any repositories are welcome. If your profile looks like a match, you will hear from us within two weeks of applying. We look forward to hearing from you.

description.text:
Är du trött på att AI fastnar i styrgrupper och processer? Eller trött på att bygga smarta demos utan att kunna ta dem hela vägen till robust produktion hos kund? Accelerate är i en sweet spot mellan storbolagets muskler och startupens tempo. Du får jobba med kunder och uppdrag som kräver senioritet, ansvar och säker leverans, men i en organisation där beslut tas snabbt och där du faktiskt får påverka riktning, best practices och hur vi bygger AI-lösningar över tid
Din roll Som AI Engineer kombinerar du praktisk utveckling med tekniskt ledarskap och kundkontakt. Du tar ansvar för arkitekturen, bygger lösningar tillsammans med utvecklingsteamet och hjälper kunden att välja teknik utifrån verksamhetsnytta, säkerhet och kostnad.
Du bidrar också till våra gemensamma arbetssätt inom AI och delar erfarenheter från kunduppdragen med kollegor.
Vad du kommer att göra

Leda kunddialoger och workshops för att identifiera konkreta AI-möjligheter


Designa och utveckla LLM-applikationer, AI-agenter och RAG-lösningar


Integrera AI med kundens befintliga system och processer


Ta lösningar från prototyp till produktion, med ansvar för arkitektur, säkerhet, drift och uppföljning


Guida utvecklingsteam i arkitektur, kvalitet och tekniska vägval


Vem vi söker Vi letar efter dig som byggt AI-lösningar som används i produktion och är trygg med att ta tekniska beslut i komplexa miljöer. Du trivs nära både koden och kunden och kan förklara tekniska vägval för människor med olika bakgrund.
Vi tror att du har gedigen erfarenhet av:

Python och backend-utveckling


LLM-baserade applikationer och RAG


Azure eller AWS


Att driftsätta och vidareutveckla AI-lösningar, exempelvis med CI/CD, containrar, MLOps eller LLMOps


Erfarenhet av dataplattformar och uppdrag med höga krav på säkerhet eller informationshantering är meriterande.
Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska. För denna position krävs svenskt medborgarskap. Vi utför även bakgrundskontroll av slutkandidat.
Varför Accelerate? Hos oss får du ta dig an kvalificerade kunduppdrag tillsammans med kunniga kollegor inom AI, data, utveckling, moln och infrastruktur. Du får möjlighet att pröva idéer, diskutera tekniska vägval och utveckla lösningar där flera kompetenser möts.
Som anställd får du också:

Utbildning och certifieringar via partners som Red Hat, HashiCorp, GitLab och Microsoft


Kollektivavtal, friskvårdsbidrag och sjukvårdsförsäkring


Flexibilitet och möjlighet till balans mellan arbete och fritid


Placeringsort Accelerate finns på flera orter i Sverige och Norge. För denna tjänst utgår du från vårt kontor i Linköping, med möjlighet till hybridarbete.
Önskad start är snarast eller enligt överenskommelse. Har du frågor? Kontakta Jesper Carlsson på jesper.carlsson@iver.se
Vi ser fram emot att träffa dig. Välkommen till Accelerate!

description.text:
Who We Are
We are a well-funded, early-stage technology company on a mission to fundamentally redefine the way the world searches, discovers, and interacts, built on a philosophy that puts the user first at every step. 
The user is not simply a means of transaction. They are a valued participant whose data works for them, not against them, enriching their world and their own experience within it, with them retaining full control.
Our mission is underpinned by proprietary, patent-pending technology built on a novel engine and system.


The Problem You Will Be Solving
The internet was built to inform the many, not to serve the individual. Platforms optimize for engagement, extraction, and consumption at global scale. AI has made this model even more efficient, with the user still largely remaining the input, not the full beneficiary.
The problem is not information. The world has never had more. The problem is that people give away a lifetime of data without receiving the personalized experience it should enable.
People should not have to search. They should simply find.


Who You Are
•      Highly talented and motivated to build products with people, for people
•      You thrive in zero-to-one environments and find genuine satisfaction in creating from scratch
•      A fast-paced thinker with a relentless desire to learn, improve, and raise the standard around you
•      Able to inspire, elevate, and collaborate; you make the people around you better
•      A great communicator; you express complex ideas with clarity, precision, and confidence across all levels of the organization
•      Able to transform ideas into working systems and technical milestones with light speed and precision
•      Highly ambitious and action-driven; you thrive under pressure and find genuine energy in working at the edge of what is considered possible
•      Capable of designing and building production-grade systems in a fourth of the time most experienced and “sane” professionals would consider possible


What You Will Do
•      Build large-scale graph systems that model relationships and behavioral patterns from user interaction signals
•      Design and operate dynamic graph analytics pipelines for pattern detection and structural analysis
•      Build graph neural network architectures to learn rich representations of users and their connections
•      Design efficient graph maintenance and serving pipelines for updates, change detection, and low-latency access
•      Build privacy-preserving graph infrastructure that supports aggregate insights while protecting individual data
•      Apply graph-based techniques to enterprise scenarios involving organizational and relational data


Minimum Qualifications
•      MSc in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or Network Science from KTH, Chalmers, Uppsala, or an institution of equivalent standing
•      Genuine theoretical depth in graph machine learning; GNNs, spectral methods, graph embeddings, and community detection with clear understanding of assumptions and failure modes
•      Experience implementing graph ML methods in PyTorch Geometric, DGL, or equivalent frameworks
•      Demonstrated capability to take a sound research approach and engineer it into a system that operates reliably on real data at production scale
•      Exceptional candidates from industry backgrounds who have built graph-based systems in production will be considered alongside research candidates


Preferred Qualifications
•      PhD in graph machine learning, network science, complex systems, or a directly related field; given significant weight in our assessment
•      Research publications in graph ML, dynamic networks, community detection, or spatiotemporal modeling
•      Understanding of privacy-preserving techniques applied to behavioral data at scale
•      1–5 years of experience; research depth weighted equally with industry tenure


What We Offer
Expect the most talented, rigorous, and driven colleagues you have worked with; people who lift each other up and hold each other to the highest standard. This company is driven by ideas and innovation, regardless of age, position, or background. The best ideas must win and the people behind them recognized and rewarded.
A home for exceptional people and geniuses within their domain; those who have always known what they are capable of and have been waiting for the environment to prove it to the world, whilst first being seen and supported by their coworkers.
Compensation includes an attractive salary and meaningful equity ownership.
 
Equal Opportunity
We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work and reach their full potential. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.


Application
To apply, send your CV/resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on how and why you would like to contribute to our mission. Upon initial acceptance, an online interview will follow shortly.
Please note that all applications and interviews are conducted in English. Fluency in written and spoken English is a requirement for all roles.
All applications are treated with strict confidentiality.

description.text:
Vill du vara med och forma nästa generations data- och AI-förmåga i ett av Sveriges mest välkända familjeföretag? Hos Spendrups byggs en modern dataplattform från grunden och tar klivet direkt in i framtidens tillämpade AI.
Om tjänsten
Spendrups är ett stolt familjeföretag i fjärde generationen där traditon möter ständig innovation. Med cirka 1 100 medarbetare på bryggerier i Grängesberg, Hällefors och Visby, samt kontor och terminaler runt om i Sverige, är de en av landets ledande dryckesproducenter.
Spendrups AI-landskap är just nu under uppbyggnad, vilket ger dig en unik möjlighet att vara med från ett tidigt skede och påverka arkitektur, tekniska vägval, arbetssätt och hur de omsätter AI till konkret verksamhetsnytta för allt från logistik och sälj till produktion.  
Som Senior Data & AI Engineer får du en nyckelroll i att omsätta verksamhetsbehov till robusta, säkra och skalbara lösningar. Du blir en del av ett mindre, tvärfunktionellt team med stort mandat att driva utvecklingen framåt. Hos Spendrups arbetar du genom hela livscykeln: ena dagen utvecklar du en datapipeline eller datamodell i Microsoft Fabric och dbt, nästa dag bygger du en AI-agent, en MCP-lösning eller en integration som låter en språkmodell använda verksamhetsdata på ett kontrollerat sätt.
Spendrups arbetar iterativt och produktnära: identifierar rätt problem, testar hypoteser snabbt och realiserar det som ger effekt. Du kombinerar hands-on utveckling med tekniskt ledarskap och hjälper Spendrups etablera moderna arbetssätt för AI engineering - med fokus på kvalitet, säkerhet, kostnadsuppföljning och faktisk nytta. 
Arbetsuppgifter
Dataplattform & Pipelines: Designa och utveckla datapipelines, datamodeller och plattformskapabiliteter i Microsoft Fabric och dbt.  
Tillämpad AI i produktion: Utveckla och produktionssätta AI-lösningar, såsom AI-agenter, RAG-arkitekturer, semantisk sökning och intelligenta arbetsflöden.  
System- & Modellintegration: Integrera språkmodeller med verksamhetsdata, API:er och verktyg i Azure och Microsoft Foundry.  
Kvalitetssäkring & Evals: Etablera tester och utvärderingar (evals, observability, guardrails) som mäter kvalitet, tillförlitlighet och kostnad i våra lösningar.  
Verksamhetsnära utveckling: Arbeta nära verksamheten för att identifiera use-cases, bygga prototyper och omsätta dem till skalbara lösningar.  
Tekniskt ledarskap: Bidra till teknisk riktning, kodgranskning, CI/CD, dokumentation och gemensamma engineering-principer.

Vi söker dig som har
Flera års erfarenhet inom Data Engineering, samt att du under senare tid arbetat med eller skiftat fokus mot AI Engineering.
Mycket goda kunskaper i Python och SQL med erfarenhet av att skriva testbar, produktionsredo kod.
Erfarenhet av Azure (eller liknande molnmiljöer), moderna dataplattformar, ETL/ELT-flöden samt datamodellering.
Praktisk förståelse för generativ AI och språkmodeller (exempelvis RAG, embeddings, vektorsökning eller AI-agenter).
Erfarenhet av API-integrationer, Git, CI/CD och automatisering.
Förmåga att bedöma tekniska lösningar utifrån skalbarhet, säkerhet och mätbar verksamhetsnytta.

Det är meriterande om du har:
Erfarenhet av Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft Foundry eller Azure AI-tjänster.
Hands-on erfarenhet av dbt för strukturerad datamodellering.
Kunskap om agentiska arbetsflöden, prompt/context engineering, guardrails och utvärderingsramverk (evals).
Erfarenhet av vektordatabaser och arbete med ostrukturerad data.
Erfarenhet av MLOps/LLMOps, data governance och Power BI.

 
Personliga egenskaper
Vi söker dig som kombinerar ett starkt engineering-mindset med nyfikenhet på hur AI kan förändra arbetssätt och beslut. Du tycker om att gå från ett otydligt verksamhetsproblem till en fungerande lösning, men förstår också att verkligt värde uppstår först när lösningen är säker, mätbar, förvaltbar och används i vardagen. Du tar initiativ, experimenterar pragmatiskt och delar öppet med dig av lärdomar. Samtidigt är du trygg i att välja bort teknik som inte löser rätt problem och i att balansera innovation med kvalitet, ansvar och långsiktighet.
Vår rekryteringsprocess
Denna rekryteringsprocess hanteras av Academic Work och vår kunds önskemål är att alla frågor rörande tjänsten skickas till Academic Work.
Vi tillämpar löpande urval och kommer plocka ner annonsen när tillräckligt många kandidater har nått slutskedet i rekryteringsprocessen. Vid ansökan efterfrågas ett CV. Personligt brev använder vi inte som urvalsmetod och behöver därför inte bifogas. Rekryteringsprocessen innehåller två urvalstest: ett personlighetstest och ett test i kognitiv förmåga. Testerna är ett verktyg för att kunna hitta den kandidat med högst potential för tjänsten samt främja jämlikhet, mångfald och en rättvis rekryteringsprocess.

  • Mycket goda kunskaper i Python och SQL med erfarenhet av att skriva testbar, produktionsredo kod.
  • Erfarenhet av Azure (eller liknande molnmiljöer), moderna dataplattformar, ETL/ELT-flöden samt datamodellering.
  • Praktisk förståelse för generativ AI och språkmodeller (exempelvis RAG, embeddings, vektorsökning eller AI-agenter).
  • Erfarenhet av API-integrationer, Git, CI/CD och automatisering.
  • Förmåga att bedöma tekniska lösningar utifrån skalbarhet, säkerhet och mätbar verksamhetsnytta.

Det är meriterande om du har:

  • Erfarenhet av Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft Foundry eller Azure AI-tjänster.
  • Hands-on erfarenhet av dbt för strukturerad datamodellering.
  • Kunskap om agentiska arbetsflöden, prompt/context engineering, guardrails och utvärderingsramverk (evals).
  • Erfarenhet av vektordatabaser och arbete med ostrukturerad data.
  • Erfarenhet av MLOps/LLMOps, data governance och Power BI.

 

Personliga egenskaper

Vi söker dig som kombinerar ett starkt engineering-mindset med nyfikenhet på hur AI kan förändra arbetssätt och beslut. Du tycker om att gå från ett otydligt verksamhetsproblem till en fungerande lösning, men förstår också att verkligt värde uppstår först när lösningen är säker, mätbar, förvaltbar och används i vardagen. Du tar initiativ, experimenterar pragmatiskt och delar öppet med dig av lärdomar. Samtidigt är du trygg i att välja bort teknik som inte löser rätt problem och i att balansera innovation med kvalitet, ansvar och långsiktighet.

Vår rekryteringsprocess

Denna rekryteringsprocess hanteras av Academic Work och vår kunds önskemål är att alla frågor rörande tjänsten skickas till Academic Work.

Vi tillämpar löpande urval och kommer plocka ner annonsen när tillräckligt många kandidater har nått slutskedet i rekryteringsprocessen. Vid ansökan efterfrågas ett CV. Personligt brev använder vi inte som urvalsmetod och behöver därför inte bifogas. Rekryteringsprocessen innehåller två urvalstest: ett personlighetstest och ett test i kognitiv förmåga. Testerna är ett verktyg för att kunna hitta den kandidat med högst potential för tjänsten samt främja jämlikhet, mångfald och en rättvis rekryteringsprocess.

31599524.headline: AI Engineer inom Integration och Utveckling till tekniskt bolag

description.text:
Vill du arbeta praktiskt med AI och vara med och utveckla lösningar som gör skillnad i tekniska system? Har du erfarenhet av AI-utveckling, algoritmer eller integration av AI-lösningar och vill vara med och bygga upp något nytt? Då kan rollen som AI Engineer vara nästa steg för dig!
OM TJÄNSTEN:
Friday söker för kunds räkning en AI Engineer till en ny satsning inom data och AI. Du blir en del av ett växande team med AI- och dataingenjörer som tillsammans med kollegor från flera olika teknikområden arbetar med att utveckla och implementera nya AI-lösningar.
I rollen kommer du att arbeta med att integrera AI-lösningar i olika tekniska plattformar och system. Du kommer även att arbeta med AI-algoritmer och bidra till att utveckla lösningar som gör det möjligt att använda data på nya sätt. Arbetet är praktiskt och utvecklingsnära, där du får möjlighet att gå från idé och analys till implementation och fungerande lösningar.
Eftersom verksamheten befinner sig i en uppbyggnadsfas får du möjlighet att påverka både tekniska vägval och arbetssätt. Du kommer att samarbeta med utvecklare, dataingenjörer och andra tekniska funktioner för att identifiera behov och omsätta dem till användbara AI-lösningar.
ARBETSUPPGIFTER:
Utveckla och integrera AI-lösningar i olika tekniska system och plattformar
Arbeta med implementation och anpassning av AI-algoritmer
Utveckla tekniska lösningar för att använda AI i befintliga och nya system
Arbeta med datahantering och integrationer kopplade till AI-lösningar
Testa, utvärdera och förbättra AI-baserade funktioner
Samarbeta med utvecklare, dataingenjörer och andra tekniska team
Bidra till utvecklingen av nya metoder och arbetssätt inom AI-området

VI SÖKER DIG SOM:
Har en relevant teknisk utbildning inom exempelvis datateknik, teknisk fysik, matematik, AI, maskininlärning eller liknande område
Har praktisk arbetslivserfarenhet från minst ett projekt där du arbetat med AI-algoritmer, AI-utveckling eller integration av AI-lösningar
Har programmeringskunskaper och erfarenhet av att själv utveckla och implementera tekniska lösningar
Har förståelse för hur AI-lösningar kan integreras med andra system och plattformar
Har mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska då båda språken används i arbetet

Det är meriterande om du har:
Erfarenhet av Python
Erfarenhet av maskininlärning eller utveckling av AI-modeller
Kunskaper inom exempelvis PyTorch, TensorFlow eller liknande ramverk
Erfarenhet av API och systemintegration
Erfarenhet av att implementera AI-lösningar i produktionsmiljö
Erfarenhet av arbete med större datamängder

För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du är nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och tycker om att omsätta tekniska idéer till fungerande lösningar. Du har ett stort intresse för AI och motiveras av att utforska hur tekniken kan användas i praktiken. Vidare är du självgående, initiativtagande och trivs i en miljö där du får vara med och påverka hur både tekniska lösningar och arbetssätt utvecklas. Du uppskattar även att samarbeta med andra och dela med dig av dina kunskaper.
OM KUNDFÖRETAGET:
Kundföretaget är ett etablerat teknikbolag som utvecklar produkter och system för samhällsviktiga verksamheter. Företaget satsar på att utveckla sin förmåga inom data och AI och bygger nu upp nya tekniska lösningar och arbetssätt inom området.
Här får du möjlighet att vara med tidigt i utvecklingen av en ny verksamhet och arbeta tillsammans med ingenjörer från flera olika teknikområden. Du får en roll där du kan bidra praktiskt till hur AI integreras och används i framtida tekniska system.
OM ANSTÄLLNINGEN:
Detta är ett konsultuppdrag vilket innebär att du kommer att vara anställd av Friday och arbeta som konsult ute hos vår kund.
ÖVRIG INFO:
Omfattning: Heltid
Start: Enligt överenskommelse
Placering: Solna Strand, Stockholm
Lön: Marknadsmässig månadslön

Observera att tjänsten är säkerhetsklassad och kräver att du genomgår och godkänns i en säkerhetsprövning enligt gällande säkerhetsskyddsregler. För vissa tjänster kan särskilda krav kopplade till medborgarskap förekomma.
Ansök genom att klicka på länken nedan. Kom ihåg att vara snabb med din ansökan då vi gör löpande urval av kandidater och att annonsen kan stängas ner innan tjänsten är tillsatt om vi gått över till urvals- och intervjufasen. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via mail.
OM FRIDAY:
På Friday brinner vi för att ge dig som Tech-talang en riktigt bra start på karriären. Genom att lyssna på vad just du vill och drivs av, matchar vi dig med företag och möjligheter som får dig att se fram emot att gå till jobbet.
Vi värderar ambition och potential högt och arbetar aktivt för en fördomsfri rekrytering, där alla ges samma chans att lyckas.
Vi finns i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, Linköping och Örebro. Varje år genomför vi över 5 000 karriärmöten och matchar kandidater med allt från globala företag till innovativa startups.
Sökord: AI Engineer, AI Developer, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning Engineer, AI Integration, AI Algorithms, Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, System Integration, Software Engineer, Machine Learning, AI Development, API, Data Science, Stockholm

description.text:
Cambio is one of the Nordics' leading suppliers in e-health with a comprehensive offering for the entire health and care chain. Our e-health solutions supports health care professionals in their daily work and offer patients safer and more easily accessible care. We are proud to be an important part of Swedish healthcare. We are growing continuously and now have about 1000 employees in several countries.

The position Imagine being able to improve how an entire company works through AI.
As AI Enablement Lead, you will help teams across Cambio identify opportunities, solve real business problems and turn ideas into working AI solutions that save time, improve quality and create measurable business value.
You will be part of our virtual AI engineering team; an internal AI acceleration team focused on helping nearly 1,000 colleagues work smarter through practical AI solutions. From building agents and automations to supporting Product Engineers and scaling successful initiatives, you will play a key role in shaping how AI is adopted across Cambio.
This is a hands-on builder role. You are expected to create solutions, not just talk about them.
What You'll Be Doing
Build

Prototype and build AI agents, automations, internal applications and workflows.


Work directly with users to turn real problems into working solutions.


Use Microsoft 365, Copilot and modern AI technologies to rapidly test, iterate and deploy solutions.


Create reusable components and patterns that accelerate future development.


Drive

Own and shape the pipeline of AI opportunities across Cambio.


Prioritize initiatives, support Product Engineers and remove blockers.


Ensure delivery remains focused on measurable business value.


Enable

Help teams identify opportunities where AI can improve everyday work.


Run workshops, demos and coaching sessions that drive adoption.


Capture and share proven patterns, solutions and best practices.


Scale

Identify solutions with broader potential across Cambio.


Partner with the AI Platform Team to turn successful initiatives into scalable capabilities.


Feed recurring needs and learnings back into the platform roadmap.


How You'll Work
You will work in a highly iterative way:
Discover → Build → Test → Adopt → Measure → Scale
One day you might be building an AI agent with a business team, the next supporting Product Engineers or helping scale a successful solution across the organization.
This role sits at the intersection of product, engineering, enablement and operations.

About you

Builder: You enjoy turning ideas into working solutions and getting them into the hands of users.


AI-native: AI is already a core part of how you solve problems and create value.


Technically capable: You are comfortable working with code, APIs, automation, agents and modern AI tooling.


Business-minded: You care about solving real problems and delivering measurable outcomes.


Influential: You can work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and help drive adoption.


Technical Experience
We believe you have experience in several of the following areas:

5+ years of modern software development.


2+ years of building AI-powered solutions, agents, automations or copilots.


Experience with Microsoft technologies such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft Graph, Entra ID, Power Platform or Azure AI services.


Experience integrating systems through APIs and building workflow automations.


Experience using AI-assisted development tools in day-to-day software development.


Experience taking solutions from prototype to production and adoption.


Experience with one or more modern programming languages such as Python, C#, Java, JavaScript or TypeScript


 Place of employment: Stockholm eller Linköping 
Scope: Full-time, hybrid work model (three days per week in-office)
Form of employment: Permanent employment, 6 months trial period
Additional Information: The role involves access to sensitive information, therefore a background check will be conducted on the final candidate.
We review applications and conduct interviews on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible via the link.
We look forward to receiving your application!
CAMBIO- FOR A HEALTHIER TOMORROW
Welcome to a company where healthcare is improved every day. Here you will work with leading technology in a collaborative, trusting and empowering environment where your contribution will be appreciated and celebrated. In our caring culture you will have the opportunity to pursue different paths of professional growth. Seize the opportunity to do the most important work of your life. Read more about us here!
 A healthier tomorrow also means taking care of those who make it possible -explore our employee benefits
Learn more about our recruitment process here
Are you interested in Cambio but you don’t feel that this position is the perfect match? Check out our other open positions at our career site.

description.text:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry. 
Assignment Description
We are looking for an experienced AI Engineer to develop next-generation AI solutions for an automotive wiring harness engineering organization.
You will design, build, and implement AI-powered tools that help engineers analyse technical drawings, 3D models, electrical schematics, and engineering documentation. Your work will focus on automating engineering workflows, improving design validation, identifying potential issues, and increasing development efficiency.
Work arrangement: On-site at the client’s office 3–5 days per week. Remote work is not available.
What You Will Work On
Design and develop AI-powered tools for wiring harness engineering.
Analyse engineering drawings, 3D models, schematics, and technical documentation using AI.
Develop tools to support drawing review and schematic validation.
Identify design inconsistencies, potential issues, and opportunities for improvement.
Integrate AI solutions with engineering software and existing systems.
Automate engineering workflows to improve quality and reduce development time.
Collaborate with engineering and software teams to translate technical needs into AI solutions.
Contribute to the development of an AI platform for wiring harness design and development.

What You Bring
Strong experience in software development and system integration.
Hands-on experience with AI/ML, Generative AI, or related technologies.
A degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
Experience with technical drawings, CAD systems, or product development environments.
Strong communication skills and the ability to connect engineering requirements with software solutions.
A practical, analytical, and solution-oriented approach.

Meritorious
Previous experience with the client.
Experience in wiring harness design and development.
Knowledge of CAD tools such as CATIA, Creo, or NX.
Experience with schematic design tools such as E3, Capital, Zuken, or Saber.
Familiarity with PLM systems and product data management.
Experience with Computer Vision and document intelligence.
Experience developing AI solutions for engineering, manufacturing, or automotive applications.

description.text:
As a market-leading credit management company, Intrum has a broad competence in debt collection services, and we do business in 20 countries in Europe. We have more than 10,000 experienced employees in our group.
Our business is about helping others. Helping indebted individuals to get out of difficult situations. Helping businesses get paid so they can grow, hire and prosper. Which in turn is positive for the entire economy. You become an essential part of this circle with us, which gives your job at Intrum a deeper meaning. Regardless of your role or title. 
Being at the forefront is everyone's job. As the market leader, it is up to us to be at the forefront. Shaping the industry. Setting new standards. And wherever in the world your Intrum career path takes you, whatever role you play, you will contribute to growth, innovation and impact that makes a real difference.
To have the opportunity to grow. In our organization there are many opportunities to advance, specialize and rotate. Or even try your wings abroad. It's up to you to make it happen. The fact that our business is about helping others – individuals and companies, means that your work also develops on a more personal level. Simply put, you will grow by making a difference.
The role
 
We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to design, build and operate AI solutions using text, voice and conversational interfaces. You will collaborate with colleagues across product, data, operations, sales, customer interaction, risk and compliance to deliver secure, reliable and useful AI solutions.


The role will report to Head of Data, AI, & Automation.
Location for this position is Stockholm (Sickla)
Hybrid work. We see that hybrid work, where we as employees can work either from home or from the office, creates opportunities to perform and work effectively in virtual and real environments.
 
Purpose of role
Build reliable and scalable AI solutions that improve customer interactions, support employees and automate business processes. Turn emerging AI capabilities into production-ready services that are secure, measurable and easy to integrate with existing platforms.
Design and build AI applications using text, voice and conversational interfaces.
Develop agentic AI solutions that interact with data, tools and business systems.
Integrate AI services with platforms such as Genesys, ElevenLabs or similar technologies.
Build solutions using advanced AI models provided through APIs.
Ensure strong performance for Swedish text, speech and audio.
Take AI solutions from prototype to production, including testing, deployment and monitoring.
Evaluate solution quality, reliability, response time and cost.
Improve solutions based on user feedback and operational results.
Apply security, data protection and responsible AI practices.
Document technical solutions and support knowledge sharing across teams.
Work with business and technology teams to identify and deliver valuable AI use cases.

 
Your Background
 
You have a degree, or equivalent experience, in computer science, engineering, data science, AI or a related field.
 
We believe you also have:
Experience building and operating AI-enabled applications.
Strong programming skills, preferably in Python.
Experience working with advanced AI models through APIs.
Experience with text, speech, audio or conversational AI, preferably in Swedish.
Experience building agentic AI solutions that interact with tools, data and business systems.
Experience across the AI development lifecycle, including testing, deployment and monitoring.
Experience integrating with communication, contact-centre or voice platforms such as Genesys, ElevenLabs or similar.
Understanding of APIs, cloud platforms and modern software engineering practices.
Awareness of security, data protection and responsible AI.
Good communication and collaboration skills.
Experience from financial services, customer service or another regulated industry is an advantage, but not essential.

Who are you
We at Intrum want to contribute to an inclusive and diverse working life. We accept our differences and know that this is a strength. We know that we are all a resource for society, regardless of age, functional ability, gender, religion, ethnicity or sexual orientation. Therefore, we encourage everyone to apply for a job with us. Come as you are.
You act according to our values. Our values ​​are not words. They are everything.
Behind our global expansion and major digital transformation are four simple but powerful values. Ethics. Devotion. Solutions. Empathy. It is the value that drive our everyday life, regardless of how big we become. Others may think they are small things. But for us, they are everything.
Only applications received through our online system will be considered.

description.text:
About the Role
We are looking for an AI Engineer to join our technology team in Gothenburg. In this role, you will contribute to the development and integration of AI-powered solutions that support our internal operations and business processes. You will work with modern AI technologies, including large language models (LLMs), to build intelligent applications, automate workflows, and improve operational efficiency. The position combines AI application development with backend engineering and system integration, offering the opportunity to work on practical AI solutions in a collaborative environment.
What You'll Do
Design, develop, and maintain AI-powered applications and internal tools.
Integrate LLMs and AI services with existing enterprise systems.
Develop and maintain backend services, APIs, and AI-driven workflows.
Implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) solutions and knowledge retrieval capabilities.
Support the deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement of AI applications.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and implement AI-driven improvements.
Ensure the reliability, security, and maintainability of developed solutions.

What You'll Bring
A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience with Python and software development.
Familiarity with REST APIs, backend services, and system integration.
Understanding of LLMs and AI application development.
Familiarity with Git, Docker, and modern software development practices.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Good communication skills and proficiency in English.

Why Join Us?
You will be part of a collaborative team working on innovative technologies and practical AI applications. We offer an international working environment where you can contribute to meaningful projects, develop your technical expertise, and help shape how AI technologies are applied across the organization.
Öppen för alla
Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.
