description.text:
We are looking for a Forward Deployed AI Engineer to join our growing tech development team, building products for the financial industry. Much of the risk, compliance and regulatory work in financial services still runs on spreadsheets and manual reconciliation. We are building the intelligence platform that changes that, and we need engineers who can build it and put it into production for clients. 
We are hiring two Forward Deployed AI Engineers for our tech development team. Forward deployed means you own a module from design to a client running it: you develop on our platform, deploy it in live environments used by clients, connect their data, get the numbers right and hand over something their risk and finance teams use every day. Some weeks are pure product engineering/development; others are spent working downstream with client environments, client data and their stakeholders. 
Advisense is building the next generation intelligence on Palantir Foundry, working side by side with Advisense’s regulatory specialists, the people who understand what the numbers are and the regulations mean. The work spans data ingestion and pipelines, backend logic, APIs and user interfaces, across areas such as credit risk, capital, AML, KYC and regulatory reporting. 
AI is an integral part of how we work. Claude Code, Codex and Foundry’s AI tooling are part of our working day, while AI is also embedded in the products we build. You are expected to use AI effectively and critically, while taking responsibility for understanding, validating, testing and maintaining everything you deliver. 


As part of our tech development team, you will: 


Take modules from technical design through implementation, release, monitoring and iteration. 



Implement modules at clients, including data onboarding, integration, validation and go-live. 



Build data pipelines, backend services, APIs and frontend applications. 



Turn complex financial and regulatory requirements into clear and useful product features. 



Build AI-enabled workflows with appropriate evaluation, monitoring and human oversight. 



Work closely with product owners, senior engineers, regulatory consultants and client teams. 

Background and Experience 
Professional proficiency in both Python and TypeScript. 



Experience building and maintaining production software. 



Experience building polished user interfaces together with product teams. 



Practical experience with APIs, data modelling, integrations and data pipelines. 



Experience deploying, monitoring and troubleshooting applications in production. 



Hands-on experience building applications with AI and an effective AI-assisted development workflow. 



A strong approach to testing, maintainability, security and privacy. 
Comfortable working directly with clients and their data. 



Professional proficiency in English. Swedish is appreciated but not required. 



Experience with Palantir Foundry is a strong plus. Experience from financial services, GRC, AML, KYC, credit risk or another regulated environment is beneficial but not required. 
Who you are 
We are looking for a pragmatic and self-driven engineer who enjoys taking ownership from idea to production. You do not need to be an expert in every layer – what matters is that you are comfortable working broadly, learn quickly and approach unfamiliar problems pragmatically. 
You use AI tools critically and take responsibility for the quality of what you deliver. You also enjoy working close to the business and the client, understanding their needs and turning complex requirements into solutions that work in practice. 
You will join a small, collaborative development team where you will deliver modules and client implementations independently, with support from senior engineers, product owners and Advisense’s regulatory specialists. 
Additional Information 
We review applications continuously, so don’t wait—apply as soon as you’re ready! As long as the job posting is live, the position is still available. 
Our selection process is designed to highlight your strengths through interviews, a technical case and reference checks. We focus on competencies throughout the process and strive to make your experience as smooth as possible by keeping you informed along the way. 
To comply with GDPR regulations, we do not accept applications via email. Please submit your application through the official application portal. 
Company Description: 
Advisense has grown to become a market-leading expert company in governance, risk, and compliance (GRC). Through the acquisition of Transcendent Group in 2022, we are now the largest independent consulting firm in the Nordics in this area, helping our clients with advisory, services, technology, and fund solutions. We strive to be the best workplace for GRC experts and have more than 450 employees at our offices in Sweden, Denmark, Finland, Germany, Lithuania and Norway.

  • Build AI-enabled workflows with appropriate evaluation, monitoring and human oversight.


  • Work closely with product owners, senior engineers, regulatory consultants and client teams.

Background and Experience

  • Professional proficiency in both Python and TypeScript.


  • Experience building and maintaining production software.


  • Experience building polished user interfaces together with product teams.


  • Practical experience with APIs, data modelling, integrations and data pipelines.


  • Experience deploying, monitoring and troubleshooting applications in production.


  • Hands-on experience building applications with AI and an effective AI-assisted development workflow.


  • A strong approach to testing, maintainability, security and privacy.
  • Comfortable working directly with clients and their data.


  • Professional proficiency in English. Swedish is appreciated but not required.


Experience with Palantir Foundry is a strong plus. Experience from financial services, GRC, AML, KYC, credit risk or another regulated environment is beneficial but not required.

Who you are

We are looking for a pragmatic and self-driven engineer who enjoys taking ownership from idea to production. You do not need to be an expert in every layer – what matters is that you are comfortable working broadly, learn quickly and approach unfamiliar problems pragmatically.

Additional Information

  • Personal and professional growth through self-leadership and continuous development.

  • Benefits such as our share based reward program Eken, company pension plan, employee offer for banking products, health insurance.

" Join our team and...

be a part of an international team of professionals, who are jointly delivering challenging projects, maximizing customer value and increasing Swedbank’s competitive advantage." Laurynas Ptasnikas, your future leader

We look forward to your application at 31.10.2026 the latest.

description.text:
Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.
We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.
Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.
Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.
The Role
 As Etraveli Group rapidly expands its agentic AI ecosystem, we are looking for a hands-on engineer to serve as the core technical muscle for our AI Optimization team. In this role, you will rapidly build, test, and evaluate agentic MVPs using Python, APIs, and LLM frameworks. You will design rigorous evaluation pipelines to prove accuracy, latency, and ROI, ensuring all agents align with company principles. Once validated, you will act as the key technical stakeholder translating prototypes into clean specifications for our core Technology team to scale.
Responsibilities
 Rapid Prototyping & MVP Engineering
Build functional end-to-end agents using Python, LLM frameworks, APIs, and databases.
Spin up infrastructure (vector/relational databases, docker containers) for real-world testing.
Select architectural patterns (API wrappers, lightweight RAG, function calling).
Iterate based on business feedback and discard when concepts prove unviable.



Data Rigor & Technical Evaluation
Design evaluation pipelines to benchmark accuracy, hallucination rates, latency, and cost.
Build ground-truth labeled evaluation sets with business owners to validate production readiness.
Analyze discrepancies between agent outputs and human decisions during pilots.
Support business stakeholders in taking responsibility for prompts and business logic.
Continuously test new AI models and tools against internal benchmarks.



Feasibility & Technical Discovery
Assess operational workflows with strategy teams to determine agentic feasibility and scope difficulty.
Evaluate new agent architectures and AI tooling to recommend core platform adoption.



Handoff & Platform Stakeholder
Serve as the primary technical stakeholder to the core technology AI platform team.
Translate validated MVPs into clear technical specs, architecture diagrams, and data flows.
Partner with AI platform team to ensure seamless absorption of MVP logic into internal SDKs.



Requirements
Must Have
3+ years software engineering experience with strong Python and rapid prototyping skills.
Hands-on experience with LLM orchestration (tool use, RAG, structured outputs via LangChain, LlamaIndex, LiteLLM, or APIs).
Proficiency in API design, SQL, and relational/vector databases.
Experience using evaluation frameworks (Ragas, DeepEval, LangSmith) to benchmark performance.
Agile, pragmatic mindset for fast experimentation outside traditional sprint cycles.
Ability to convert complex business logic into concise specs for engineering teams.



Nice to Have
Background as a Forward-Deployed Engineer, Solutions Architect, or similar fast-delivery role.
Familiarity with modern deployment stacks (FastAPI, Docker, serverless).
Domain experience in travel tech, airline distribution, or payments.
Basic product management understanding (ROI tracking, KPIs, user validation).



Benefits
The culture at Etraveli Group embraces complexity and we like to keep the entrepreneurial spirit even as we grow into being a larger company. With us you can enjoy:
A flexible working environment. We work on a hybrid-model where you can choose to work two days from home and you will have two weeks per year that you can choose to work from a remote location.
Modern office in the heart of the city – A bright and central location with great access to public transport, lunch spots, and parks just around the corner.
Healthcare allowance – Each employee receives a maximum allowable amount each year according to the Swedish Tax Agency to spend on health-promoting activities such as a gym card, massage etc.
Pension and health insurance – Through partners we offer a comprehensive pension and health insurance so that you can get help quickly in case of an accident.
Daily breakfast – To kick the day off just right, breakfast is available at the office every morning.

As part of this recruitment process, we will be conducting background checks. You will be able to read more information and give your consent to this process in the application form.

description.text:
Do you want to build computer-vision technology that helps autonomous drones understand and navigate the real world?

At Robotto, we build advanced autonomy and software solutions for drones and unmanned systems. Our work brings together computer vision, edge computing, software, electronics and real-world product development.We are looking for a Senior Computer Vision & AI Engineer to take a leading technical role in developing and improving the perception capabilities behind our drone platform.You will work on challenging real-world problems where robust vision, accurate localisation and reliable performance matter. This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys going beyond algorithms and prototypes to build computer-vision solutions that perform reliably in demanding real-world environments.

The role:
You will join a highly technical engineering team working on autonomy for drones and unmanned systems.You will take significant ownership of computer-vision capabilities supporting object detection, tracking, visual localisation, visual-inertial odometry and other perception-related challenges.You will work closely with software, control, flight-test and electronics colleagues to turn computer-vision concepts into robust, deployable solutions.As a senior engineer, you will also contribute to architecture and technical decisions, help strengthen engineering practices and share your experience with other engineers across the team.

What you will do:
- Design, develop, test and improve advanced computer-vision algorithms for Robotto's drone and autonomy platform.
- Take technical ownership of computer-vision problems from exploration and prototyping through implementation, evaluation and deployment.
- Work with object detection, tracking, visual localisation, visual-inertial odometry, visual SLAM and related perception challenges.
- Build robust solutions that can perform under changing environmental and operational conditions.
- Optimise computer-vision solutions for deployment on edge and resource-constrained computing platforms.
- Define appropriate datasets, test scenarios, evaluation methods and performance metrics.
- Contribute to architecture and technical-design decisions across the perception stack.
- Collaborate closely with software, control, flight-test and electronics engineers to integrate perception capabilities into the wider platform.
- Investigate complex technical issues, validate results and drive practical improvements.
- Contribute to code quality, testing, documentation and engineering practices.
- Share knowledge and provide technical guidance to other engineers where relevant.

What success could look like in your first 3-6 months:
- You have developed a strong understanding of Robotto's autonomy platform, architecture and computer-vision priorities.
- You have taken ownership of one or more important perception challenges and are driving them towards robust solutions.
- You have contributed meaningful improvements to areas such as object detection, tracking, localisation or visual-inertial odometry.
- Your solutions are being evaluated against real-world data and operational scenarios.
- You are contributing to architecture and technical decisions across the computer-vision stack.
- You are collaborating effectively across computer vision, software, control and flight testing.
- You have become a trusted senior technical contributor within the engineering team.

What we are looking for:
We are looking for an experienced engineer with a strong computer-vision foundation and a track record of turning complex technical ideas into practical, working systems.
- 5+ years of relevant professional experience preferred, with significant hands-on expertise in computer vision, robotics, machine learning, autonomy or a closely related field.
- Strong practical knowledge of computer vision, with experience in areas such as object detection, tracking, visual localisation, visual-inertial odometry, visual SLAM or related perception methods.
- Strong C++ programming skills, with Python experience for algorithm development, experimentation, testing and prototyping.
- Experience taking computer-vision or machine-learning solutions beyond research and prototyping into real products or deployed systems.
- Experience designing, training and evaluating deep-learning models for computer-vision applications.
- Experience deploying and optimising models or computer-vision algorithms on edge or resource-constrained computing platforms is highly relevant.
- Strong understanding of algorithm evaluation, datasets, testing methodologies and measurable performance criteria.
- Experience contributing to architecture or technical-design decisions within complex software or perception systems.
- A good understanding of how vision systems interact with cameras, sensors, software, compute platforms and real-world environments.
- Experience with drones, robotics, autonomous systems or embedded-adjacent software is a strong advantage.
- Experience mentoring, supporting or sharing technical knowledge with other engineers is an advantage.
- Professional fluency in English.
- A degree in computer vision, robotics, computer science, engineering or a related technical field is preferred; equivalent industry or research experience is equally welcome.

Who you are:
You are technically curious, analytical and comfortable taking ownership when the answer is not immediately obvious.You enjoy going deep into difficult technical problems, while keeping sight of the goal: building technology that works reliably in the real world.
- You take ownership of technical problems and drive them towards practical solutions.
- You are comfortable making technical decisions and explaining the trade-offs behind them.
- You challenge assumptions constructively and are willing to explore new approaches.
- You care about robustness, testing and measurable performance.
- You collaborate naturally across computer vision, software, control, electronics and flight testing.
- You enjoy sharing knowledge and helping others solve difficult technical problems.
- You are comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve as the company and technology develop.

More information and application:
https://careers.robotto.ai/jobs/8259919-senior-computer-vision-ai-engineer

description.text:
Vi söker en AI Engineer som vill bygga lösningar som faktiskt används i verksamheten. För dig är AI inte en demo vid sidan av, utan ett verktyg för att lösa riktiga problem, automatisera arbete och skapa bättre sätt att jobba.

Du gillar att bygga, testa och få saker i produktion. Hos oss arbetar du nära både kunden och tekniken och behöver därför vara lika nyfiken på problemet som på modellen, arkitekturen eller verktyget som kan lösa det.

Vad du kommer att göra

Du kommer bland annat att:

designa, bygga och vidareutveckla lösningar med generativ AI, LLM:er, agents och automation
koppla AI till affärssystem, dataplattformar, API:er och andra verksamhetskritiska system
välja rätt angreppssätt för exempelvis retrieval, tool use och agentbaserade flöden
ta lösningar från idé och proof of concept till robust implementation och produktion
arbeta med utvärdering, testning, säkerhet, behörigheter och spårbarhet
samarbeta nära kunder för att förstå processer, data och behov och omsätta dem till fungerande lösningar


Vem vi tror att du är

Du har minst fyra års relevant erfarenhet inom systemutveckling, data, AI eller liknande och har byggt moderna AI-lösningar i praktiken.

Du behöver inte komma från klassisk machine learning eller forskning. Det viktiga är att du kan bygga fungerande produkter, integrationer och automationer och förstår vad som krävs för att få dem att fungera utanför en demo.

Vi tror också att du:

är en stark utvecklare och känner dig hemma i exempelvis Python, TypeScript, C# eller liknande
har erfarenhet av LLM-baserade lösningar och hur de kopplas till data, verktyg och externa system
är van vid API:er, integrationer och moderna moln- och utvecklingsmiljöer
förstår hur AI kan kopplas till ERP-miljöer som SAP, datalager och andra affärssystem
kan resonera kring säkerhet, behörigheter och dataskydd
är pragmatisk, självgående och bekväm med att välja teknik utifrån problemet snarare än leverantören
kan prata med både verksamheten och tekniska team
kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska


Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av AI-agenter, moderna integrationsmönster för AI eller plattformar och modeller från exempelvis OpenAI, Anthropic eller Microsoft.

Du behöver inte kunna allt. Det viktiga är att du har en stabil teknisk grund, är nyfiken och vill fortsätta utvecklas tillsammans med oss.

Varför Norrminds?

Du börjar inte på Norrminds bara för att få ett nytt jobb.

Vi bygger ett bolag där människor med olika styrkor får stort ansvar, kan påverka hur vi arbetar och hjälper varandra att bli bättre. Vi tror på modet att testa gränser, på att göra saker tillsammans och på att teknik ska skapa nytta, inte bara mer teknik.

Vi arbetar i gränslandet mellan AI, affärssystem, integration och automation. Här får du arbeta nära de processer och system där AI faktiskt kan göra skillnad och samtidigt vara med och forma hur vi bygger vårt AI-erbjudande framåt.

Rollen kan utgå från Malmö, Linköping eller Stockholm. I dessa städer vill vi bygga något långsiktigt, så du ska tycka om tanken på att vara nära både kunder och framtida kollegor och vara med och forma Norrminds lokalt.

Känner du igen dig? Då vill vi gärna höra från dig.

Design and build agentic workflows powered by LLMs, vector search, and knowledge graphs

Shape the product, the stack, and the culture from the ground up

Top-tier compensation package

description.text:
Vi söker en Project Manager som vill leda förändring där verksamhet, affärssystem och ny teknik möts. För dig handlar projektledning inte bara om planer och deadlines, utan om att förstå vad som behöver förändras och få människor, teknik och beslut att dra åt samma håll.

Du gillar att skapa struktur i komplexa sammanhang och röra dig mellan verksamheten och tekniska team. Hos oss kan projekten handla om AI, ERP och affärssystem, integrationer, automation eller andra digitala förändringar.

Vad du kommer att göra

Du kommer bland annat att:

leda projekt från förstudie och behovsanalys till implementation och uppföljning
skapa struktur kring mål, scope, plan, budget, risker, beroenden och beslut
leda workshops och hjälpa verksamheten att konkretisera behov och målbild
översätta mellan verksamhet, IT, utvecklingsteam, leverantörer och andra intressenter
arbeta nära tekniska team och förstå hur system, data, processer och integrationer påverkar leveransen
koordinera test, införande, förändring och övergång till förvaltning när det behövs
skapa tydliga beslutsunderlag och kommunicera framdrift, risker och vägval
utmana krav och arbetssätt när det finns ett bättre sätt att nå målet


Vem vi tror att du är

Du har minst fyra års relevant erfarenhet av projektledning, verksamhetsutveckling eller digital transformation och har lett initiativ där verksamhet och IT behöver fungera tillsammans.

Du behöver inte vara SAP-konsult, utvecklare eller AI Engineer. Däremot är du tekniskt nyfiken, kan snabbt sätta dig in i nya systemmiljöer och är bekväm med att arbeta nära både verksamheten och de som bygger lösningen.

Vi tror också att du:

har drivit IT-, system- eller transformationsprojekt från behov till genomförande
är van vid krav, processer, workshops och intressenthantering
förstår grunderna i affärssystem, integrationer och data
kan växla mellan helhet och detaljer och själv ta tag i analys eller krav när det behövs
förstår att införande av ny teknik också handlar om människor, arbetssätt och förändring
har börjat använda AI som ett naturligt verktyg i ditt eget arbete
är tydlig, prestigelös och trygg i dialog med både projektteam och beslutsfattare
driver saker framåt utan att behöva bli detaljstyrd
kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska


Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av ERP- eller affärssystemsprojekt, SAP, AI-initiativ, automation, integrationer, systemimplementationer eller större förändringsprogram.

Det viktiga är inte vilken projektmodell du föredrar eller hur många certifieringar du har. Vi lägger större vikt vid att du kan förstå problemet, skapa förtroende och driva en komplex leverans hela vägen fram.

Varför Norrminds?

Du börjar inte på Norrminds bara för att få ett nytt jobb.

Vi bygger ett bolag där människor med olika styrkor får stort ansvar, kan påverka hur vi arbetar och hjälper varandra att bli bättre. Vi tror på modet att testa gränser, på att göra saker tillsammans och på att teknik ska skapa nytta, inte bara mer teknik.

Vi arbetar i gränslandet mellan AI, affärssystem, integration och automation. Som Project Manager får du arbeta nära både tekniken och verksamheten och vara med där idéer blir till lösningar och nya arbetssätt.

Rollen kan utgå från Malmö, Linköping eller Stockholm. I dessa städer vill vi bygga något långsiktigt, så du ska tycka om tanken på att vara nära både kunder och framtida kollegor och vara med och forma Norrminds lokalt.

Känner du igen dig? Då vill vi gärna höra från dig.

description.text:
The role
You’ll work within the AI team reporting to the AI & Innovation Lead. You will be primarily supporting R&D and Solutions but collaborating with all teams, to embed AI into Prover’s engineering workflows and help shape our next generation of AI-powered products, initially for railway signaling, and over time for safety-critical systems more broadly.
You will:
Build AI agents and assistants that accelerate formal verification and engineering workflows
Evaluate and integrate agent SDKs (e.g., Anthropic Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, or similar) to build our own internal AI platform
Prototype AI-powered features for Prover Station, our digital twin and formal verification platform
Explore how LLMs can accelerate the adoption of formal methods in safety-critical domains

What we’re looking for
A hands-on builder who has shipped tools or prototypes using LLMs or AI agents, professionally, inside projects, or in open source
Deeply curious about AI and the fast-moving landscape of agent frameworks and developer tooling
Comfortable across the stack. We care more about builder mindset than a specific language or framework
Strong communicator who enjoys collaborating with domain experts in formal methods and signaling
Motivated by impact. Rail is one of the most energy-efficient modes of transport, and that matters to you

Nice to have:
Experience with agent SDKs and platforms
Familiarity with formal methods such as formal logic, formal specification, model checking, proof-oriented programming, and theorem proving
Experience building internal developer tools or platforms
Interest in domain-specific languages and how AI can make them more accessible

description.text:
We're looking for a Senior AI Engineer
Join us in transforming the digital signage landscape. PLAYipp, the leading Nordic digital signage company, is seeking a senior engineer to own features end-to-end — from PRD to Production — which increasingly include building AI capabilities directly into our product. At PLAYipp, we don't write code by hand — everything is built by directing AI coding tools (we use Claude Code), and you're fully accountable for what ships, however it was written. You'll be working in a Team, alongside Product and fellow Engineers — each of you carrying a bigger slice of the work than in a traditional setup, but never working alone.
About PLAYipp
At PLAYipp, we deliver comprehensive, user-friendly digital signage solutions that empower businesses to communicate effectively and innovate. Our platform enables organizations of all sizes to manage and showcase content seamlessly across various screens, enhancing communication and customer engagement.
We're also at the forefront of how software gets built, constantly pushing for new ways to work more efficiently with AI without ever compromising on code quality. If you like being at that edge, this is the place.
Key role description
You own features end-to-end: front end, back end, testing, and the architecture decisions along the way. You're never on your own with this — your team, our chief architect, and our Head of AI are there to support you whenever you need it.
Beyond product features, you'll also help build AI into how the whole organization works — tools that let AI handle work that used to require an engineer.
What we expect from you
Building, Testing & Maintaining the Product

Take requirements from PRD to finished, deployed feature.


Write and maintain tests as part of building — quality is your responsibility.


Ownership — you ship it, you're responsible for it in production.


Think about scalability and architecture, together with our Chief Architect, as a natural part of building, not an afterthought.


Building AI Into the Product

Build AI-powered capabilities into the PLAYipp product itself.


Work with LLM APIs and related tooling to get these features to production, not just prototypes.


Internal AI Enablement

Occasionally build internal tooling that helps the wider organization become more self-sufficient with AI — e.g. giving non-engineers direct, self-serve access to data that used to require an engineer.


Bring in new AI tools and workflows as they prove useful, and keep pushing for more efficient ways to work with AI without compromising quality.


Team Collaboration & attitude

Share knowledge — on architecture, testing, deployment, and AI tooling — through documentation and workshops.


Help team members grow their technical skills, including AI-assisted development.


Lead by example in communication, drive and creativity.


Foster a collaborative, learning-oriented team culture.

Required CompetenciesTechnical Skills
7+ years of professional experience in full-stack development, with demonstrated progression in technical complexity and responsibility.


Practical experience building AI/LLM-powered features in a production product.


Strong expertise in TypeScript, React, and Node.js — enough to review, judge, and be fully accountable for AI-generated code. Even though AI writes it, you own every line and are the one who fixes it when it breaks.


Deep understanding of modern web application architecture, including RESTful APIs.


Proficient with relational databases (MySQL or similar), including schema design, query optimization, and data modeling.


You shouldn't have been coding manually for some time; Claude Code experience specifically isn't required, but AI-directed development should already be how you work.


Comfortable with ownership, not just writing code and passing it along.


Nimble and adaptable — comfortable moving between product feature work and internal tooling/enablement work as priorities shift.

Location & Schedule
Hybrid but primarily based, 3 days/week minimum, at PLAYipp HQ in central Gävle.


Core collaboration hours for team synchronization.

Why Join PLAYipp?
Work with a talented and enthusiastic team in an innovative and growing company.


Shape how AI gets built into a market-leading product, not just talk about it.


Be part of a small, tight-knit team where you carry real ownership — without working alone.


Enjoy a dynamic and collaborative work environment that values creativity and initiative.


Opportunity to make a significant impact on the digital signage industry.


Competitive salary and benefits package.


If you're ready to build the future of digital signage with AI at the core of how you work, apply today.
Locations: PLAYipp HQ Gävle Remote status: Hybrid

description.text:
SAVR is a fast-growing Swedish fintech company on a mission to reinvent investing. We empower investors with a platform that offers lower fees, greater transparency, and a radically improved experience.
We’re not just building another investment service — we’re reimagining how financial products should work for people, not just institutions. As part of our ambitious, innovative and curious team, you’ll help shape the future of investing in Sweden and beyond.
A quick note: This is not a traditional hiring process. While we're not actively looking to fill an immediate vacancy, we're always interested in meeting exceptional people who can help shape SAVR's future. If there's a strong mutual fit, we're open to exploring opportunities together
The Role – AI Engineer
As an AI Engineer with backend skills in our cross-functional team, you’ll join our tech team in Stockholm or Halmstad to build AI-powered product experiences end-to-end. You’ll work closely with fellow Software Engineers, Product Designers, and Product Managers to ship LLM-driven features such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), semantic search, intelligent assistants, and automation, built for reliability, security, and great UX.
Our Tech Team Lead will manage and support your work, while reporting directly to our VP of Engineering. A glimpse into our tech stack: Python, SQL, Terraform, hosted on AWS, plus an AI stack that includes LLM APIs/open-source models, vector databases/similarity search, retrieval pipelines, evaluation tooling, and observability for production AI.
Your Mission
Build and ship LLM-powered product features (RAG, assistants, semantic search).


Productionize AI systems with guardrails, monitoring, evals, and cost/latency control.


Partner with product/design/engineering to turn use cases into measurable outcomes.


Build and maintain key platform features, APIs, and services, prioritizing scalability, reliability, and top-tier performance.


Provide direction and strategic insight on data related topics.

Additionally you will
Drive ideas and develop concepts from a tech perspective.


Explore ideas iteratively and refine them into production-quality solutions.


Contribute to improving the architecture, tech stack, and operational methods.


Improve our AI development workflow to support safe and reliable production AI.


Follow and promote good engineering practices to deliver high-quality products.


Engage in code reviews and foster a culture of continuous learning through constructive feedback.


Be a positive force for our team culture.

You’ll Thrive in This Role If You...
4+ years of professional team-based software development experience, with at least some experience building ML/AI-powered features or systems in production.


Experience working with scalable, product-based environments, where you’ve shipped user-facing features and care about latency, reliability, and real-world constraints.


Solid understanding of backend systems and data modeling, enough to build reliable text retrieval, integrate with existing services, and reason about data quality, privacy, and access control in AI workflows.


Passion for applied AI, including prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings/vector search, LLM evaluation, fine-tuning, and model serving.


Strong collaboration skills and an open-minded approach to exchanging ideas.


Fluent in English and a team player who values diverse perspectives.


Swedish citizen or valid EU work permits (we cannot offer visa sponsorship for this role).


We’re seeking a motivated engineer with a broad skill set and a passion for applied AI, especially LLM-powered products, retrieval, and production-grade AI systems. You are someone who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment and is eager to contribute to building something great.
Our Cultural DNA
At SAVR, we’re:

🧠 Open-minded – we embrace new ideas, diverse perspectives, and continuous learning
🚀 Bold – we take smart risks, move fast, and aren’t afraid to fail forward
🤝 Honest – we value transparency, feedback, and doing the right thing 
We’re a startup, so things can be a little messy — and that’s part of the thrill. If you thrive in building as a team and handling uncertainty, you will fit right in. 
What’s In It for You
You’ll join a product- and design-driven company where your work has real impact. We keep things lean, move fast, and genuinely care about the experience we deliver — for customers and for each other.
Here’s what we offer:
💻 Top-tier work gear
💰 Competitive salary
🏃‍♀️ Generous wellness allowance
🤒 Insurance package
🌱 Occupational pension and long-term savings support
🏢 Office-first approach to foster collaboration and quick decision-making — with flexibility when you need it (4+1)

description.text_formatted:
SAVR is a fast-growing Swedish fintech company on a mission to reinvent investing. We empower investors with a platform that offers lower fees, greater transparency, and a radically improved experience.

We’re not just building another investment service — we’re reimagining how financial products should work for people, not just institutions. As part of our ambitious, innovative and curious team, you’ll help shape the future of investing in Sweden and beyond.

A quick note: This is not a traditional hiring process. While we're not actively looking to fill an immediate vacancy, we're always interested in meeting exceptional people who can help shape SAVR's future. If there's a strong mutual fit, we're open to exploring opportunities together

The Role – AI Engineer

As an AI Engineer with backend skills in our cross-functional team, you’ll join our tech team in Stockholm or Halmstad to build AI-powered product experiences end-to-end. You’ll work closely with fellow Software Engineers, Product Designers, and Product Managers to ship LLM-driven features such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), semantic search, intelligent assistants, and automation, built for reliability, security, and great UX.

Our Tech Team Lead will manage and support your work, while reporting directly to our VP of Engineering. A glimpse into our tech stack: Python, SQL, Terraform, hosted on AWS, plus an AI stack that includes LLM APIs/open-source models, vector databases/similarity search, retrieval pipelines, evaluation tooling, and observability for production AI.

Your Mission

  • Build and ship LLM-powered product features (RAG, assistants, semantic search).

  • Productionize AI systems with guardrails, monitoring, evals, and cost/latency control.

  • Partner with product/design/engineering to turn use cases into measurable outcomes.

  • Build and maintain key platform features, APIs, and services, prioritizing scalability, reliability, and top-tier performance.

  • Provide direction and strategic insight on data related topics.

Additionally you will

  • Drive ideas and develop concepts from a tech perspective.

  • Explore ideas iteratively and refine them into production-quality solutions.

  • Contribute to improving the architecture, tech stack, and operational methods.

  • Improve our AI development workflow to support safe and reliable production AI.

  • Follow and promote good engineering practices to deliver high-quality products.

  • Engage in code reviews and foster a culture of continuous learning through constructive feedback.

  • Be a positive force for our team culture.

You’ll Thrive in This Role If You...

  • 4+ years of professional team-based software development experience, with at least some experience building ML/AI-powered features or systems in production.

  • Experience working with scalable, product-based environments, where you’ve shipped user-facing features and care about latency, reliability, and real-world constraints.

  • Solid understanding of backend systems and data modeling, enough to build reliable text retrieval, integrate with existing services, and reason about data quality, privacy, and access control in AI workflows.

  • Passion for applied AI, including prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings/vector search, LLM evaluation, fine-tuning, and model serving.

  • Strong collaboration skills and an open-minded approach to exchanging ideas.

  • Fluent in English and a team player who values diverse perspectives.

  • Swedish citizen or valid EU work permits (we cannot offer visa sponsorship for this role).

We’re seeking a motivated engineer with a broad skill set and a passion for applied AI, especially LLM-powered products, retrieval, and production-grade AI systems. You are someone who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment and is eager to contribute to building something great.

Our Cultural DNA

At SAVR, we’re:

🧠 Open-minded – we embrace new ideas, diverse perspectives, and continuous learning

🚀 Bold – we take smart risks, move fast, and aren’t afraid to fail forward

🤝 Honest – we value transparency, feedback, and doing the right thing

We’re a startup, so things can be a little messy — and that’s part of the thrill. If you thrive in building as a team and handling uncertainty, you will fit right in. 

What’s In It for You

You’ll join a product- and design-driven company where your work has real impact. We keep things lean, move fast, and genuinely care about the experience we deliver — for customers and for each other.

Here’s what we offer:

💻 Top-tier work gear

💰 Competitive salary

🏃‍♀️ Generous wellness allowance

🤒 Insurance package

🌱 Occupational pension and long-term savings support

🏢 Office-first approach to foster collaboration and quick decision-making — with flexibility when you need it (4+1)

Our Commitment to Diversity

SAVR is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome people from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. We believe diverse teams build better products and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.

Ready to Join Us?

We’d love to hear from you. Apply now or reach out with any questions — and let’s build something meaningful together.

description.text:
Sana is an AI lab building superintelligence for work. We believe organizations can accomplish their missions faster when teams can effortlessly access knowledge, automate repetitive work, and learn anything with the help of agentic AI. As part of Workday, we are committed to building AI that augments people - not replaces them.
We bring this mission to life through two products. Sana Agents provide a seamless way to access all your company’s apps, knowledge, and data, enabling AI agents to do real work so teams can process and act on information at unprecedented scale. Sana Learn is an AI-powered learning hub that combines the simplicity of a modern learning platform with intelligent features like an AI tutor, automated content generation, and interactive apps, making knowledge not just accessible but actionable.
We’re a talent-dense, product-obsessed team of engineers and designers from companies like Google, Spotify, Apple, and Databricks, united by deep technical excellence and rapid iteration. Our tools already help over a million people learn and work better across hundreds of leading enterprises - and we’re just getting started.
About the Role
You'll build the core agent infrastructure that powers Sana's mission to bring superintelligence to work. This is a greenfield opportunity to define how AI agents plan, reason, and execute across enterprise environments—building systems that reliably handle real-world complexity at scale. You'll work at the intersection of agent architecture, context-, tool- and prompt engineering, and production infrastructure.
In this role, you will
Architect multi-step planning, orchestration, and tool routing for agents
Implement code generation agents and sandboxed code execution
Engineer memory, state, and context packing/grounding strategies
Balance latency, quality, and cost controls for agent execution
Develop safe fallbacks, graceful degradation and robust error handling
Collaborate with platform and search teams to deliver reusable agent infrastructure
Establish safety guarantees and measurable quality improvements
About You
Basic Qualifications:
3+ years of software engineering experience building production backend or platform systems.
3+ years of experience in TypeScript, with a strong track record of writing reliable, maintainable services.
3+ years of experience with distributed systems, APIs, asynchronous workflows, and service-oriented architecture.
3+ years of experience designing systems with a focus on scalability, reliability, observability, and maintainability.
Other Qualifications:
Experience building and deploying LLM-powered applications in production.
Experience building agent platforms or AI infrastructure.
Deep understanding of the low-level details of the OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic LLM APIs, including tool calling, system prompt caching, etc.
Familiarity with LLM application patterns, including tool calling, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), memory and context management, multi-step orchestration, and human-in-the-loop systems.
Experience building and running machine learning systems in production, including compiling training and test datasets, building training pipelines, evaluating models, and detecting and handling drift (neural networks, Gaussian models, Thompson sampling, etc.).
Experience designing evaluation frameworks for LLM or agent quality and safety, including hands-on use of platforms such as Langfuse or LangSmith.
Familiarity with vector databases, prompt and context engineering, and experimentation tooling.
Experience working with sandbox environments such as Modal, and designing strict access control models to keep user data safe and encrypted at all times.
Experience running services in Kubernetes-based environments on GCP or equivalent cloud platforms.
Comfort working with Postgres and Redis in high-throughput, low-latency service contexts.
Contributions to open source TypeScript projects.
Ability to navigate ambiguity, make strong technical tradeoffs, and drive projects from concept to production.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to partner effectively across engineering, product, and AI research teams.

description.text:
AI förändrar hur företag utvecklar produkter, effektiviserar verksamheter och skapar nya affärsmöjligheter. På Knowit Solutions vill vi ligga i framkant – och nu söker vi en person som vill vara med och driva vår AI-utveckling, både internt och tillsammans med våra kunder.
Vi söker dig som kombinerar en stark teknisk bakgrund inom systemutveckling med praktisk erfarenhet av att bygga moderna AI-lösningar, framför allt inom generativ AI. Du trivs lika bra med att utveckla lösningar som att inspirera kollegor, hålla workshops och hjälpa kunder att hitta rätt väg framåt.
Hos oss blir du en central del av vår AI-satsning. Du kommer att stötta våra utvecklingsteam med kompetens och vägledning, bidra till att höja vår interna AI-mognad och vara en nyckelperson i dialogen med kunder. Samtidigt kommer du själv att arbeta i konsultuppdrag där du designar och utvecklar AI-lösningar som skapar verkligt affärsvärde.
I rollen kommer du att
Vara en drivande kraft i vår AI-satsning och bidra till att utveckla vårt erbjudande.


Stötta och coacha våra utvecklingsteam kring AI, generativ AI och moderna utvecklingsverktyg.


Hjälpa våra team att använda AI för ökad produktivitet och högre kvalitet i utvecklingen.


Designa och implementera AI-lösningar tillsammans med våra kunder.


Delta i kunddialoger och hjälpa kunder att identifiera hur AI kan skapa affärsnytta.


Planera och genomföra AI-workshops, inspirationssessioner och förstudier.


Hålla dig uppdaterad kring den snabba utvecklingen inom AI och omsätta nya möjligheter i praktiken.


Arbeta i konsultuppdrag med fokus på AI och modern systemutveckling.

Vi tror att du
Har flera års erfarenhet av systemutveckling.


Har praktisk erfarenhet av att utveckla och implementera AI-lösningar, gärna med fokus på generativ AI, LLM, RAG, AI-agenter och liknande tekniker.


Har god förståelse för hur AI integreras i moderna system och affärsprocesser.


Är bekväm med både kod, arkitektur och tekniska vägval.


Tycker om att dela med dig av kunskap och coacha andra utvecklare.


Är trygg i dialogen med kunder och kan förklara komplex teknik på ett tydligt och engagerande sätt.


Har ett konsultmässigt förhållningssätt och trivs med att skapa långsiktiga kundrelationer.


Är nyfiken, prestigelös och drivs av att utforska nya möjligheter.

Därför Knowit Solutions
Hos oss får du möjlighet att vara med och forma hur vi arbetar med AI – inte bara i våra kundprojekt utan också internt. Du får stor möjlighet att påverka våra arbetssätt, vår kompetensutveckling och vårt erbjudande samtidigt som du arbetar tillsammans med några av branschens mest kompetenta utvecklare.
Vi söker inte bara någon som vill bygga AI-lösningar. Vi söker någon som vill hjälpa både våra kunder och våra kollegor att lyckas med AI.
Ansökan
Välkommen med din ansökan redan idag, rekrytering sker löpande. Vi genomför även bakgrundskontroll på slutkandidat. Har du frågor? Kontakta rekryteringsansvarig Carolina Jonsson carolina.m.jonsson@knowit.se
Knowit är ett nordiskt konsultbolag som hjälper företag, myndigheter och organisationer att  lyckas i den digitala transformationen. Med expertis inom systemutveckling, AI,  cybersäkerhet, molntjänster, digitala kundupplevelser och managementkonsulting  utvecklar vi lösningar som bidrar till ett mer hållbart och mänskligt samhälle.
Vi är cirka 3 700 medarbetare och arbetar genom våra affärsområden Solutions,  Experience, Connectivity, Insight och Products – främst i Norden, men även i Polen, Serbien och Tyskland.We don’t wait for the future. We build it.

description.text:
På Knowit Core i Malmö kombinerar vi modern systemutveckling med den senaste AI-tekniken för att skapa smarta, skalbara lösningar som ger konkret affärsvärde för våra kunder.
Nu söker vi en AI Engineer som vill vara med och bygga nästa generation backend- och cloudlösningar tillsammans med utvecklare, arkitekter, data engineers och AI-specialister.
Det här är en möjlighet för dig som vill utvecklas i framkant inom generativ AI, arbeta i tekniknära team och omsätta nya idéer till robusta lösningar i produktion.
Om rollen
Som AI Engineer hos oss utvecklar du AI-drivna system och integrationslösningar i cloudmiljöer som Azure, AWS och GCP. Fokus ligger på backendutveckling, AI orchestration och integration av språkmodeller i skalbara system och plattformar.
Du kommer att arbeta i projekt där AI är en central del av lösningen och där tekniken används i produktion för att automatisera processer, förbättra beslutsstöd och skapa nya användarupplevelser.
Hos oss handlar AI inte om isolerade demos eller chatbotar, utan om robusta lösningar som integreras i verksamhetskritiska system och arbetsflöden.
Du kommer att arbeta med
• Integration av språkmodeller som GPT, Claude eller Mistral i backend och affärssystem • AI orchestration och agentbaserade arbetsflöden • RAG arkitektur och integration mot interna datakällor • Semantic search och vektorsökning • LangChain, Semantic Kernel eller liknande AI ramverk • API utveckling och integration mellan AI tjänster och interna plattformar • Backendutveckling i Python, TypeScript eller liknande språk • AI lösningar i distribuerade system och cloudmiljöer • Containerplattformar och Kubernetes • Infrastruktur som kod och automatiserade deployments • Utveckling av AI funktionalitet som används i produktion och skapar konkret affärsvärde
Vi söker dig som: Vi tror att du har några års erfarenhet av backendutveckling, cloud eller distribuerade system och att du under de senaste åren har arbetat praktiskt med AI-integrationer, LLM-lösningar eller agentbaserade system.
Meriterande Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av flera av följande områden:
• Python eller TypeScript • Backendutveckling och API-design • Azure, AWS eller GCP • LangChain, Semantic Kernel eller liknande AI-ramverk • LLM-integrationer och generativ AI • RAG och semantic search • Vektordatabaser som Pinecone, Weaviate eller Azure AI Search • Distribuerade system och integrationslösningar • Kubernetes och containerplattformar • DevOps, CI/CD och cloud native-utveckling
Personliga egenskaper Du har en stark teknisk grund inom backendutveckling och systemdesign, kombinerat med ett genuint intresse för hur AI kan integreras i riktiga system och plattformar.
Som person är du kommunikativ, nyfiken och lösningsorienterad. Du trivs i konsultrollen, gillar att samarbeta nära både kund och team och kan växla mellan tekniskt djup och affärsförståelse. Du uttrycker dig obehindrat på svenska och engelska.
Därför Knowit Core Malmö
Hos Knowit Core får du det bästa av två världar: närheten, entreprenörsandan och flexibiliteten i ett mindre bolag, tillsammans med styrkan, nätverket och möjligheterna i ett etablerat konsultbolag. I Malmö blir du en del av ett engagerat team av utvecklare, cloudspecialister, data engineers, arkitekter och AI-specialister som gärna delar kunskap, utmanar varandra och har roligt tillsammans.
Vi erbjuder
• Tekniskt avancerade och varierande uppdrag inom AI, cloud och backendutveckling • Möjlighet att arbeta nära den senaste utvecklingen inom generativ AI, LLM-lösningar och intelligenta arbetsflöden • Kompetensutveckling genom certifieringar, utbildningar och workshops • Tid och budget för individuell utveckling och lärande • Aktiv kunskapsdelning tillsammans med erfarna och engagerade kollegor • En stark gemenskap med workshops, träningspass, kickoffer och sociala aktiviteter
Vill du vara med och bygga nästa generation AI-drivna system tillsammans med oss och samtidigt utvecklas i en miljö där teknik, innovation och affärsnytta möts?
Varmt välkommen med din ansökan till Knowit Core Malmö.

I Malmö blir du en del av ett engagerat team av utvecklare, cloudspecialister, data engineers, arkitekter och AI-specialister som gärna delar kunskap, utmanar varandra och har roligt tillsammans.

Vi erbjuder

• Tekniskt avancerade och varierande uppdrag inom AI, cloud och backendutveckling • Möjlighet att arbeta nära den senaste utvecklingen inom generativ AI, LLM-lösningar och intelligenta arbetsflöden • Kompetensutveckling genom certifieringar, utbildningar och workshops • Tid och budget för individuell utveckling och lärande • Aktiv kunskapsdelning tillsammans med erfarna och engagerade kollegor • En stark gemenskap med workshops, träningspass, kickoffer och sociala aktiviteter

Vill du vara med och bygga nästa generation AI-drivna system tillsammans med oss och samtidigt utvecklas i en miljö där teknik, innovation och affärsnytta möts?

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan till Knowit Core Malmö.

description.text:
At Umain, we're not just creating software; we're crafting the future, one innovative project at a time. With our motto "Shape, Ship, Scale," we empower our team to not only envision the future but also play a pivotal role in building it. We're a dynamic team where you can shape the future, ship groundbreaking solutions, and scale your abilities in many different ways.
We're on the lookout for developers ready to join us in this journey, bringing passion, creativity, and dedication along with them. The role is ideal for engineers with demonstrable skills in AI as well as for software engineers who have recently transitioned to AI and ML expertise, and offers an opportunity to develop your craft whilst working closely with clients on delivering AI solutions to real-world challenges.
We are seeking an AI Engineer with experience in building robust, scaleable, AI powered solutions. The ideal candidate combines a product engineering mindset with a deep enthusiasm for advancing AI capabilities. They demonstrate a great understanding of core AI concepts, product development workflows, and embodies team spirit.
As an AI Engineer at Umain, your role will involve:
Assisting our clients in clarifying their questions and determining if using AI is a suitable solution for them


You understand the limitations of a model and how to address them within the product's UX


Experience architecting agentic solutions (context, memory, and tool/skill handling) and implementing them using frameworks such as Mastra, Microsoft Agent Framework, LangChain/LangGraph.


Applying stochastic test casing and trace-based reasoning to evaluate, test, and improve agent behaviour, supported by observability tooling (Langfuse, Promptfoo, etc.).


Understanding and applying core AI concepts such as redlining, document chunking for accuracy, efficient use of embeddings, and debugging AI systems


Validating, deploying, monitoring, and maintaining built models, ensuring they can be used at scale


Developing and maintaining end-to-end data pipelines and machine learning workflows, optimizing for performance and reliability


Working with diverse, cross-functional teams on projects that deliver groundbreaking AI solutions for global brands

We also welcome experienced software engineers looking to transition into AI:
Strong product development background with several years of software engineering experience


Active engagement in AI (agents, wrappers, context engineering)


Knows how to work efficiently in a product/engineering team

Who You Are:
We value candidates who demonstrate:

Great delivery skills: Proven capability to deliver AI solutions


Strong AI intuition: A deep understanding of AI concepts


Curiosity: Enthusiasm for emerging technologies, creativity in problem-solving, and an eagerness to learn in a rapidly evolving AI landscape


Full-stack product thinking: Frontend or backend experience outside the traditional AI field, with the ability to build end-to-end


You're a developer with a passion for innovation and a knack for problem-solving.


You're eager to learn, grow, and take on new challenges.


You value collaboration, diversity, and the opportunity to make a significant impact.


You believe in the power of technology to shape the future.

What We Offer:
A chance to work closely with global brands on a range of diverse and unique projects that explore and truly push the boundaries of what's possible.


A fun and fair work environment where you have the opportunity to expand your skills through unique challenges and fantastic colleagues.


A personal coach, and a setting where you can grow professionally and personally.


Being part of multidisciplinary teams, participating in agile teams, being an important player in a highly ambitious setting.

Why Umain?
Career Framework: We believe in fairness and clarity, which is why we've established a transparent career framework to ensure equal pay and equal opportunities for all. Your growth and success are as important to us as they are to you. Together with your coach, you will build your own development plan and grow in your career.
Work-Life Balance: At Umain, diversity is our strength. We understand that life doesn't pause when you walk into the office. That's why we've cultivated an environment that supports an excellent work-life balance. We welcome team members from all walks of life, recognizing the richness that different backgrounds, ages, and life stages bring to our team. We're committed to supporting each other, encouraging a healthy work-life balance that respects your needs, whether it's taking care of your family, your pets, or yourself.
Innovations and Learning: Technology is always evolving, bringing new challenges and opportunities for collaboration and learning. Our developers work closely with designers, analysts, testers and more to tackle these challenges head-on, sharing knowledge and growing together.
Skills Over Degrees: We're more interested in what you can do than in the diplomas you hold. Talent, drive, and creativity are what count at Umain. Here, you'll find opportunities to grow, learn, and excel in your career, regardless of your educational background. If you have the ambition and commitment to succeed, we have the environment and resources to support your journey.
Background Check: Umain conducts a background check for final candidates in accordance with our internal policies. The check is carried out only with your consent and is ordered by our CISO through our approved screening partner. The scope of the check depends on the role level. This step is performed late in the recruitment process and is used solely to support a secure and fact-based hiring decision.

description.text:
Om företaget
Valcon är ett internationellt konsultbolag som arbetar i skärningspunkten mellan affär och teknik, med fokus på att skapa datadrivna lösningar som gör verklig skillnad för sina kunder. Bolaget kombinerar strategisk rådgivning med teknisk implementation och hjälper organisationer att ta nästa steg inom digitalisering, data och AI.
Här får du arbeta i en miljö där innovation, samarbete och kunskapsdelning står i centrum. Teamet består av erfarna specialister inom data, analytics och machine learning som tillsammans driver utvecklingen framåt och skapar värde i allt från tidiga koncept till produktionssatta lösningar.
Som medarbetare erbjuds du stora möjligheter att påverka både teknikval och arbetssätt, samtidigt som du får arbeta i varierande projekt hos välkända kunder. Kulturen präglas av entreprenörsanda, nyfikenhet och en vilja att ständigt utvecklas – både som individ och som team.
Om tjänsten
I rollen som Machine Learning Engineer arbetar du nära både teknik och verksamhet för att utveckla skalbara och robusta ML-lösningar. Du blir en del av ett team där samarbete, kunskapsdelning och nyfikenhet står i fokus.
I denna roll kommer du bland annat att:
Utveckla och träna machine learning-modeller i Python (t.ex. med NumPy, Pandas och scikit-learn)
Arbeta med feature engineering, datamodellering och statistisk analys
Utvärdera och optimera modellprestanda genom tester och experiment
Bygga, underhålla och vidareutveckla ML-pipelines
Sätta modeller i produktion och säkerställa stabil drift över tid
Arbeta med MLOps, inklusive CI/CD, modellversionering och automatiserad retraining
Exponera modeller via API:er och integrera dem i affärsnära system
Arbeta med moderna teknologier såsom Azure Machine Learning, vektordatabaser och embeddings
Utveckla lösningar inom generativ AI, exempelvis RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
Samarbeta med andra utvecklare, data engineers och stakeholders för att skapa värde från data

Du kommer att arbeta genom hela ML-livscykeln – från experiment och prototyp till produktionssatta lösningar och kontinuerlig förbättring.
Vi söker dig som
Har minst 3 års erfarenhet inom Machine Learning eller liknande roll
Har goda kunskaper i Python och ML-bibliotek
Har erfarenhet av att utveckla, testa och sätta ML-modeller i produktion
Har förståelse för statistik, sannolikhetslära och modellvalidering
Har arbetat med ML-pipelines, CI/CD och MLOps
Har erfarenhet av molntjänster, gärna Azure
Är van att arbeta i team och kommunicera med både tekniska och icke-tekniska stakeholders
Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska

Övrigt
Anställningen är på heltid med en inledande provanställning på sex månader. Lön och tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse. Tjänsten är placerad i Göteborg.
I denna rekrytering samarbetar Valcon med Kraftsam Rekrytering och Bemanning. Externa rekryteringsbolag och säljare undanbedes vänligen men bestämt.
Har du frågor om tjänsten, vänligen kontakta ansvarig rekryterare Kristina Maksimovic på (https://kraftsam.ponty-system.se/assignment/1789/patricia.contreras@kraftsam.se)kristina@kraftsam.se
Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

description.text:
Driv AI-initiativ som effektiviserar mjukvaruutveckling genom intelligenta automationsflöden, Python och stora språkmodeller.
Vill du bidra till att göra mjukvaruutveckling smartare och mer effektiv? I den här seniora rollen utvecklar du AI-drivna lösningar som kombinerar etablerad automation med stora språkmodeller. Du blir en viktig del av ett team som för AI närmare ingenjörsorganisationens vardag.
Om rollen
Utveckla och vidareutveckla en AI-plattform för tekniska tillämpningar.
Fokusera på lösningar som effektiviserar mjukvaruutveckling och ingenjörsarbete.
Arbeta i ett agilt team med tydligt fokus på fungerande leveranser.
Bidra med senior kompetens inom maskininlärning och mjukvaruutveckling.

Det här kommer du göra
Bygga pipelines som stödjer eller automatiserar tekniska arbetsuppgifter.
Kombinera traditionell mjukvaruautomation med stora språkmodeller.
Konfigurera och träna maskininlärningsplattformen för olika användningsområden.
Samarbeta med andra utvecklingsteam för att omsätta behov till AI-lösningar.

Vi söker dig som har
Minst fem års relevant erfarenhet inom mjukvaruutveckling, AI eller maskininlärning.
Masterexamen inom datavetenskap, data science, mjukvaruutveckling eller närliggande område.
Mycket god förmåga att utveckla robust mjukvara och designa tekniska lösningar.
Erfarenhet av att arbeta med stora språkmodeller.
God kommunikativ förmåga och vana att samarbeta med flera intressenter.

Teknik & Verktyg
Python för utveckling och automation.
Large Language Models för AI-stödda arbetsflöden.
Machine Learning och plattformar för modellträning.
Kubernetes, containerteknik och molntjänster.
DevOps och moderna leveransflöden.

Praktisk information
Ort: Göteborg.
Arbetssätt: Ej specificerat.
Språk: Engelska, i tal och skrift.

description.text:
RaySearch develops innovative software solutions to improve cancer care. Over 1200 clinics in more than 54 countries use RaySearch software to improve treatments and quality of life for patients. RaySearch was founded in 2000 and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. The headquarters is located in Stockholm, with subsidiaries in the US, Europe, Asia and Australia & New Zealand. Today we are more than 485 employees with a common vision of improving cancer care with innovative software. Our great staff is crucial for our success and we offer a fantastic working environment in modern offices, flexibility and good opportunities for development. We believe in equal opportunities, value diversity and work actively to prevent discrimination.
RaySearch is expanding in the field of machine learning and is looking for a Machine Learning Engineer with strong software engineering skills to join our head office in Stockholm. In this role, you will have the opportunity to innovate and develop software that improves the lives of cancer patients around the world, while building the infrastructure, services, and developer tooling that enable machine learning solutions in the ML department to move efficiently from experimentation to clinical products used in cancer treatment worldwide. 
About the job
You will be part of an agile team developing machine learning solutions for radiation oncology. Our work spans areas such as image segmentation, image synthesis, treatment planning, dose prediction, and other deep learning applications within medical imaging and radiation therapy. 
You will 
Your day-to-day work will involve training, evaluating and operationalizing deep learning models. This includes analyzing results using clinical metrics and ensuring that predictions meet acceptance criteria. You will work with real clinical datasets and iterate closely with medical physicists and oncologists to validate model performance against clinical standards. 
The role combines machine learning research, experimentation and software development:
Develop state-of-the-art deep learning methods for medical imaging and radiation therapy. 
Work on problems involving 2D and 3D medical images, anatomical structures, treatment data, and multimodal clinical information
Design experiments, define appropriate evaluation methods, and analyze model behavior. 
Build and evaluate new architectures, training strategies, and research ideas and determine which approaches are worth bringing into our products
Work with large clinical datasets and develop reliable pipelines for training, validation, evaluation, and inference 
Collaborate closely with medical physicists, oncologists, researchers, product owners, and software engineers

Your profile 
You are someone who genuinely loves both ML and software engineering. You read papers, get excited about new architectures and training techniques, and have expertise in implementing them. 
You are autonomous and self-driven. Given a problem, you take ownership: you research the landscape, form a plan, and execute without needing to be guided through every step. You know when to dig deeper on your own and when to pull in a colleague. You are comfortable making decisions, and you communicate clearly about what you are doing and why. 
You contribute to a positive team atmosphere and take responsibility for your work. Above all, you care about building software that makes a meaningful impact for healthcare professionals and their patients. 
Experience & skills 
Requierments 
M.Sc. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or equivalent 
Minimum 4 years of professional experience in software development, machine learning, or a related field 
Excellent understanding of machine learning techniques and algorithms 
Strong programming skills in Python with emphasis on writing clean, maintainable, production-quality code 
Solid software engineering practices: version control, code review, testing, CI/CD 
Experience using deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch 
Solid knowledge of data structures, algorithms, statistics, and applied mathematics 
Comfort working in large, collaborative code bases and contributing to shared architecture decisions 
Excellent spoken and written communication skills in English 

Meriting 
Experience with medical image segmentation, registration, image synthesis, reconstruction, representation learning, or multimodal imaging.  
Contributions to open source projects 
Experience working in regulated or safety-critical software environments (e.g., medical devices, automotive)

Our Culture  
At RaySearch, we share a passion for innovation and the fight against cancer. Our team consists of dedicated experts who strive to deliver exceptional results through collaboration, attention to detail, and cutting-edge technology. We take pride in our role as a leader in cancer treatment, developing solutions that truly make a difference for patients worldwide.  
Our Offer  
We offer a dynamic and inclusive work environment in Hagastaden, Stockholm’s Life Science Hub. Our modern office space includes an in-house gym, yoga classes, and social activities such as ping pong, table football, and after-work events. We also provide a fantastic lunch buffet, daily fika, and a stunning rooftop terrace with a 360-degree view of Stockholm. This comes with a competitive compensation and benefits package.  
Application  
Please apply for the position through the application form below. Selection and interviews will be ongoing. We do not accept applications via e-mail.

description.text:
Om företaget
Valcon är ett internationellt konsultbolag som arbetar i skärningspunkten mellan affär och teknik, med fokus på att skapa datadrivna lösningar som gör verklig skillnad för sina kunder. Bolaget kombinerar strategisk rådgivning med teknisk implementation och hjälper organisationer att ta nästa steg inom digitalisering, data och AI.
Här får du arbeta i en miljö där innovation, samarbete och kunskapsdelning står i centrum. Teamet består av erfarna specialister inom data, analytics och machine learning som tillsammans driver utvecklingen framåt och skapar värde i allt från tidiga koncept till produktionssatta lösningar.
Som medarbetare erbjuds du stora möjligheter att påverka både teknikval och arbetssätt, samtidigt som du får arbeta i varierande projekt hos välkända kunder. Kulturen präglas av entreprenörsanda, nyfikenhet och en vilja att ständigt utvecklas – både som individ och som team.
Om tjänsten
I rollen som Machine Learning Engineer arbetar du nära både teknik och verksamhet för att utveckla skalbara och robusta ML-lösningar. Du blir en del av ett team där samarbete, kunskapsdelning och nyfikenhet står i fokus.
I denna roll kommer du bland annat att:
Utveckla och träna machine learning-modeller i Python (t.ex. med NumPy, Pandas och scikit-learn)
Arbeta med feature engineering, datamodellering och statistisk analys
Utvärdera och optimera modellprestanda genom tester och experiment
Bygga, underhålla och vidareutveckla ML-pipelines
Sätta modeller i produktion och säkerställa stabil drift över tid
Arbeta med MLOps, inklusive CI/CD, modellversionering och automatiserad retraining
Exponera modeller via API:er och integrera dem i affärsnära system
Arbeta med moderna teknologier såsom Azure Machine Learning, vektordatabaser och embeddings
Utveckla lösningar inom generativ AI, exempelvis RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
Samarbeta med andra utvecklare, data engineers och stakeholders för att skapa värde från data

Du kommer att arbeta genom hela ML-livscykeln – från experiment och prototyp till produktionssatta lösningar och kontinuerlig förbättring.
Vi söker dig som
Har minst 3 års erfarenhet inom Machine Learning eller liknande roll
Har goda kunskaper i Python och ML-bibliotek
Har erfarenhet av att utveckla, testa och sätta ML-modeller i produktion
Har förståelse för statistik, sannolikhetslära och modellvalidering
Har arbetat med ML-pipelines, CI/CD och MLOps
Har erfarenhet av molntjänster, gärna Azure
Är van att arbeta i team och kommunicera med både tekniska och icke-tekniska stakeholders
Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska

Övrigt
Anställningen är på heltid med en inledande provanställning på sex månader. Lön och tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse. Tjänsten är placerad i Stockholm.
I denna rekrytering samarbetar Valcon med Kraftsam Rekrytering och Bemanning. Externa rekryteringsbolag och säljare undanbedes vänligen men bestämt.
Har du frågor om tjänsten, vänligen kontakta ansvarig rekryterare Kristina Maksimovic på (https://kraftsam.ponty-system.se/assignment/1789/patricia.contreras@kraftsam.se)kristina@kraftsam.se
Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

31518660.headline: Thesis project: Pallet perception through deep learning and sensor fusion

description.text:
Develop methods using deep learning models to improve the current pallet perception system, with a focus on fusing model outputs with data from other sensors. The main focus will be on general pallet identification and localization.

In your Master Thesis at Toyota, you will work on:
A modern sensor system featuring:
2D RGB camera
Time-of-Flight (ToF) 3D camera
Correlation between pixels from the RGB camera and points in the 3D point cloud from the ToF camera
NVIDIA chip in an embedded environment (GPU) for data processing 


Tasks include:
Training and evaluation of deep learning (DL) models using different methodologies
Algorithm development for data fusion
Evaluation using real-world data and comparison with training results from a synthetic environment


At Toyota, we work with innovative technologies to develop our autonomous trucks. The thesis project will investigate training methodologies, model architecture, and the selection of suitable model outputs that can be effectively combined with point cloud data to accurately localize a pallet in relation to the camera position. The training data will be generated in synthetic environments, which will be provided as part of the project. Therefore, the gap between synthetic and real-world data will also need to be considered when evaluating the results. The thesis project will be carried out in close collaboration with one of Toyota's teams specializing in machine learning development.
SCOPE
 Master thesis 30 hp, 1-2 students
Requirements
For this master thesis, we are looking for students with following education or equivalent:
3D Computer vision
Deep learning specialization / Machine Learning specialization

Who is Toyota Material Handling?
 Toyota Material Handling is a global leader in material handling, and we are making significant investments to meet the needs of the future. At our site in Mjölby, 3,000 employees work across the entire material handling value chain, from development concepts to finished vehicles. Our product range spans from manual hand trucks to autonomous vehicles and innovative energy solutions.

 At Toyota Material Handling, we strive to create a friendly, safe and forward-thinking workplace. Our culture is built on Toyota's core values, where respect and consideration guide us in our daily work. Our ambition is to strengthen our competitiveness by increasing diversity across the organization and embracing our differences. 

Start
January 2027
Your application:
 Your application is individual. If you plan to do the master thesis together with another student, please specify name of that person. Latest date for application 2026-11-01.

Your application can be written in English or Swedish.

If you have any questions, please contact:
Axel Carlsson, Machine Learning Engineer, 073 052 99 63
Albin Sidås , Machine Learning Architect, 072 227 79 31
Josefin Nilsson, HR, josefin.nilsson@toyota-industries.eu

Instagram: ToyotaMHsweden
Linkedin: Toyota Material Handling Manufacturering Sweden AB
