description.text:
Drivs du av att se dina idéer bli verklighet? Välkommen till vår spännande och teknikintensiva värld.


Din Roll

Som systemingenjör inom nätverk hos oss kommer du jobba med kommunikationssystem och nätverk med våra kunder, där du ansvarar för kravnedbrytning, arkitekturfrågor och tekniska gränssnitt. Du kommer att arbeta med systemintegration på fordon och säkerställa att våra lösningar fungerar sömlöst tillsammans med fordonsplattformarnas tekniska system och kommunikationsgränssnitt.
Rollen innebär att du kommer att jobba i ett team med specialister och projektledare där du kommer att behöva kommunicera och samarbeta för att ni tillsammans ska leverera.
Huvudsakliga arbetsområden:
Integrera kommunikationssystem samt vidareutveckla och underhålla befintliga lösningar
Designa systemarkitektur och fastställa högnivåkrav
Arbeta med kravanalys - tolka, bryta ner och säkerställa krav i samarbete med projektledning, kunder och övriga intressenter
Följa systemen genom hela utvecklingsfasen, inklusive integration och verifiering
Vara ett tekniskt stöd för mjukvaruutvecklare och agera bollplank i frågor som rör struktur och leveransflöden
Delta vid driftsättning och ge support ute hos kund


Din Profil


Vi letar efter dig som är en driven, gärna erfaren ingenjör och som vill utvecklas och utmanas. Du ska ha viljan och kompetensen att lära dig våra produkter och bli en del av vårt kunniga och trevliga team. Du är troligtvis civil- eller högskoleingenjör inom nätverksteknik eller datavetenskap eller har motsvarande erfarenhet/yrkesutbildning.
Vi söker dig med brett tekniskt kunnande och ett brinnande intresse för teknik. För att trivas hos oss bör du vara självgående, ha lätt att samarbeta med andra och vara flexibel.
Vi tror att du har några års erfarenhet inom något/några av följande områden:
Systemarbete, kravhantering
Vana av att designa och implementera nätverk
Väl bekant med routingprotokoll
Vana av att ha arbetat med VoIP-baserade lösningar
IT- och nätverkssäkerhet
Anpassning och integration mellan olika tekniska system
Dokumentation och teknisk rapportering

Meriterande kunskaper:
Komplexa datornätverk, nätverksadministration och övervakning
Certifieringar inom nätverk t.ex. CCNA, CCDA
Linux, scriptning eller förmåga att läsa och förstå kod
Utbildning och handledning av andra
FMV:s kommunikationssystem eller erfarenhet från försvarsindustrin (Ruggade miljöer)
Processer för säkerhetskritiska system inom flyg (RTCA), fordonsindustrin eller medicinteknik

Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap.
Vänligen observera att vi arbetar med löpande urval och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum har gått ut.


Vad du blir en del av

Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas.
 
Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med syfte att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidra till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 28 000 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld. 
 
Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss

description.text:
I vårt team i Växjö möts djup och bred kompetens med nyfikenhet, driv och passion för teknik. Tillsammans arbetar vi med några av försvarsområdets mest avancerade radio- och telekrigssystem - och delar gärna med oss av det vi kan. Nu söker vi dig som vill bidra med både kompetens och personlighet. Hos oss får du testa idéer och utvecklas tillsammans med andra i ett team där vi delar kunskap, stöttar varandra och bygger långsiktigt förtroende hos våra kunder.




Vad vi erbjuder

Hos oss får du arbeta med avancerad teknik i projekt som stärker Sveriges försvarsförmåga. Du utvecklas tillsammans med erfarna specialister i teamet och i nära samarbete med kunder och användare. Genom utbildningar, specialistnätverk och uppdrag från idé till färdig lösning får du både fördjupa din kompetens och prova nya vägar. Vi erbjuder också goda karriärmöjligheter, konkurrenskraftiga förmåner och aktiesparprogram.




Vad rollen innebär

Som ingenjör med kunskap inom Radio arbetar du med att utveckla, prova och vidmakthålla radiosystem och materiel inom telekrigsområdet. Du följer lösningarna genom hela systemlivscykeln och bidrar med teknisk kompetens från tidiga utvecklingsfaser till driftsatta system.
 
Arbetet är varierat och passar dig som gillar att växla mellan praktiskt ingenjörsarbete, teknisk analys och problemlösning. Du provar och utvärderar system, felsöker tekniska problem och stöttar kunder och användare med din tekniska kompetens. Beroende på uppdrag arbetar du i labb- och verkstadsmiljö, hos kund eller vid tester och fältprov.
 
Exempel på arbetsområden är radiosystem och kommunikationslösningar, provning och integration, mätning och teknisk analys samt felsökning, driftstöd och teknisk rådgivning.
 
Då tjänsten innebär arbete som omfattas av försvarssekretess krävs det att du genomför och godkänns i en säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll. 
 
Urval sker löpande. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan! 
 


 

Vad vi söker

För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du brinner för teknik, tar ansvar och driver arbetet framåt. Du delar gärna idéer, lär dig nytt och behåller fokus på lösningar när utmaningarna blir komplexa. Samtidigt bidrar du till den öppna och förtroendefulla kultur som präglar både teamet och samarbetet med våra kunder.
 
Vi tror att du har en utbildning inom elektronik, elektroteknik, radioteknik eller ett liknande område, kunskap inom radiokommunikation, nätverk, IP eller närliggande teknikområden, god förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska samt möjlighet att genomföra tjänsteresor vid behov.
 
Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet från försvarssektorn eller kunskap om radio-, sambands- eller telekrigssystem. Vi värdesätter även erfarenhet av SDR, Linux, nätverksteknik, programmering, CAD-verktyg eller avancerad mätutrustning.




Övrig information

Nyfiken på att utvecklas tillsammans med oss? Skicka in din ansökan och bli en del av ett team där vi delar kunskap, stöttar varandra och omsätter vår kompetens och passion för radio, telekrig och teknisk utveckling i lösningar som stärker Sveriges försvarsförmåga.
 
Kontaktperson/rekryterande chef: cathrine.boklund (@) combitech.com

description.text:
BACKGROUND & RESEARCH PROBLEM
Construction sites are large, cluttered and constantly changing: material is moved, structures are built and removed, and people and machines share the same space. To operate autonomous machines safely and efficiently, we need rich 3D models of the worksite that carry semantic meaning and stay up to date as the environment evolves. This project investigates how to build and maintain semantic 3D maps of a worksite over extended periods of time.
OBJECTIVES
Industry: Investigate methods and tools for creating semantic 3D maps of the worksite and how to maintain them over extended periods of time.
Science
•  Investigate approaches for modelling 3D environments and their joint semantic labelling into meaningful categories such as fixed structures, ground types, materials, people and machines.
•  Investigate how semantic information can be used to intelligently partition the model into instances such as fixed structures, people, moving objects and rooms.
•  Investigate how novel measurements of the environment can be efficiently used to update the existing model and produce information about dynamics, such as how people, objects or material move in the space.
Training: Broaden knowledge of the state of the art in related fields such as 3D reconstruction, semantic labelling of 3D environments, and modelling of dynamic environments.
YOUR PROFILE
•  MSc in computer science, robotics, electrical engineering, applied mathematics, machine learning or a related field.
•  Strong programming skills (Python and/or C++) and a solid mathematical foundation.
•  Experience with one or more of: 3D perception, SLAM, computer vision, control theory or machine learning.
•  Independent, curious and rigorous, with excellent written and spoken English.
WHAT WE OFFER
•  A fully funded doctoral position working on a real industrial problem with access to unique field data from construction sites.
•  Co-supervision from academia and an experienced Volvo autonomy/perception team.
•  Compute resources (GPU clusters) and access to test machines and sensor platforms.
•  A collaborative research environment with the ambition to publish at leading venues.
SCOPE & APPLICATION
Industrial PhD position, approx. 4-5 years, based in Gothenburg, Sweden, with time split between the university and Volvo. To apply, send your CV, grade transcript and a short motivation letter. Scope and start date are agreed together with the supervisors.
 
As part of the recruitment process, a background check as well as alcohol and drug testing may be conducted. You will be informed if applicable. 


We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

description.text:
About Kitron
Kitron is a leading Scandinavian Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) company, delivering improved flexibility, cost efficiency, and innovation power through the value chain. The company has operations in Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Lithuania, Germany, Poland, the Czech Republic, India, China, Malaysia and the United States. With 2500 highly skilled employees, Kitron manufactures and delivers anything from fully assembled electronic circuit boards to complete end - products for customers globally. Related technical services like prototyping, industrialisation, material analysing and test development are also key competencies offered by Kitron.
Our values
Location: Jönköping, Torsvik Deadline: 2026-11-01
Service Desk Lead
Ready to shape the future of IT Service Management in a global technology company?

At Kitron, we are modernizing our IT landscape to create smarter, more secure, and user-friendly services that support business growth. We are looking for a proactive and strategic Service Desk Lead to drive the development, governance, and continuous improvement of our IT Service Management platform and processes.

In this role, you will act as the bridge between the business, IT partners, and service providers, ensuring high-quality service delivery, strong governance, and an excellent user experience across the organization. Global standardization and adoption  

What you'll do

Lead and develop Kitron's ITSM framework, processes, and platform


Drive continuous improvement of Service Desk services and end-user experience


Collaborate closely with business functions such as HR, Finance, Engineering, Planning, and Purchasing


Establish and follow up on SLAs, KPIs, reporting, and service performance


Support automation initiatives, workflow improvements, and AI-driven solutions


Ensure ITSM compliance with security and governance requirements


Manage vendor relationships and coordinate service improvements across internal and external teams


Platform ownership, integrations and upgrades


Global standardization and adoption


Security and compliance standards


Data-driven problem reduction



What we're looking for

3+ years of experience leading a Service Desk or IT Service Management function


Strong understanding of ITSM and ITIL best practices (certification is a plus)


Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills


Experience working with service providers and cross-functional teams


Professional proficiency in English



Why join Kitron?
You will play a key role in shaping how IT services are delivered across an international organization. You'll work closely with experienced IT specialists, business leaders, and external partners while driving meaningful improvements that create real business value.

Additional Information
Some travel may be required.
As part of our recruitment process, candidates advancing to the final stages will be required to complete a background check and security clearance assessment.

Interested? We look forward to hearing how you can help us build the next generation of IT service excellence at Kitron.
For more information about the position, please contact Ruben Hansen, IT Manager ASA, at ruben.hansen@kitron.com.

description.text:
TL;DR: We are looking for a senior engineer with deep marketing knowledge to join Applied AI, the team that rebuilds how Lovable operates as a company. You will work embedded with Marketing and build the AI systems, data, and agents that its teams run on. You will ship production software yourself, on Lovable, with the Applied AI engineers.
Why Lovable?
Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
What we're looking for
6+ years building and shipping production software or data systems that people depend on. Recent hands-on work in TypeScript, Python, or SQL.
Deep marketing knowledge from a marketing organization, a MarTech company, or a product or data role serving marketing teams. You know how paid and social channels, attribution, CRM, content, and positioning work in practice and where they break.
Experience integrating marketing systems: ad platforms, analytics, CRM or CDP, and content tools. You know their APIs and data well enough to build on them.
Experience building with LLMs: agents, evaluation, and the judgment to know where a rule-based system does the job better. You can test the quality of model output and make it reliable enough for daily use.
Strong product judgment. You start from the problem, choose priorities with the people affected, and improve a system through use and feedback.
Senior stakeholder skills. You work directly with the CMO and Marketing leads, form your own view, and disagree in writing with a better path attached.
Care for permissions and data handling. Marketing systems touch customer data and spend. You treat access control as a design requirement from day one.
Comfort building on a high-level platform. We build our internal systems on Lovable itself. Bespoke infrastructure needs a written reason.

What you'll do
Run a listening tour with Marketing. Map current work, systems, data sources, owners, and the places where expert judgment lives. Propose builds only after that.
Agree each project with Marketing leadership up front: the problem, the metric, the owner, and the definition of done.
Connect the context a launch depends on: Linear tickets, internal docs, Slack threads, competitive intel, and usage data. When the scope changes, the change propagates to every asset that mentions it.
Build agents and workflows for Performance and Social: creative variants, campaign setup, and quality checks against brand guidance, with human review where spend or brand is at stake.
Encode Brand and Product Marketing judgment into systems: positioning, messaging, and voice guidance that other teams and agents apply without a meeting.
Connect Marketing's systems to the shared company data layer so agents and workflows can act on trusted data.
Build on the shared Applied AI foundation and contribute back. Reuse company data contracts, permissions, and agent patterns. Extract what Marketing needs into reusable pieces.
Launch every system with a named owner, a runbook, access rules, and a review cadence. Teach the Marketing team to operate it without you.
Measure results with Marketing and use them to decide what to improve, extend, or retire.
Bring concrete product gaps from internal use to Lovable's product teams.

How the role fits
You report into Applied AI and spend most of your time with Marketing. Marketing leadership sets the priorities and owns the results. You agree with them on what to build, how to measure it, and who owns each system once it runs. Applied AI owns the shared foundations you build on: company data contracts, permissions, the information architecture and reusable agent patterns.
You work day to day with the Applied AI engineers and with colleagues embedded in Sales, Finance, People, and Support. A capability you build for Marketing often becomes a building block for another function, and the reverse is true too.
Our tech stack
We build with tools that both humans and AI love.
Platform: Lovable itself, Supabase (PostgreSQL), Cloudflare
Languages: TypeScript, Python, SQL, Go
AI: Anthropic, OpenAI, MCP, AI agents
Data: BigQuery
Marketing systems: the ad platforms, analytics, and CRM tools Marketing already uses

About your application
Please submit your application in English. It's our company language, so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join.
We treat all candidates equally - if you're interested, please apply through our careers portal.

description.text:
TL;DR
We're looking for an exceptional AI Software Engineer to build the AI-powered People systems that help Lovable scale.
As Lovable grows, we're rethinking how work gets done. Rather than relying on traditional HR software, we're building AI-native products that transform hiring, onboarding, workforce planning, identity, compliance, and other core People workflows.
You'll work embedded with our People team, partnering closely with stakeholders to understand problems, design solutions, and ship production-ready software. Many of the products you build won't stop at improving Lovable internally — they have the potential to become capabilities we offer to customers in the future, giving you the opportunity to shape products that start inside Lovable and scale far beyond it.
Why Lovable?
Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
Why join now?
Very few engineering roles offer this level of ownership.
You'll help define how AI transforms internal operations. You'll work directly with the People team to identify problems, design solutions, and build products that improve how Lovable operates every day.
As Lovable scales, we're building the operating system the company runs on—function by function, directly in Lovable. The People team is one of the first. You'll help define how AI transforms one of our most important internal functions, and the best ideas will eventually become building blocks for our customers.
What we're looking for
We're looking for a software engineer with strong product instincts and experience building secure software that handles sensitive information.
You'll likely have:
Experience shipping production software that handles sensitive data — HR tech, fintech, identity management, or similar.
Experience working with people data, business systems, analytics platforms, or enterprise data infrastructure (e.g. BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks, Airflow, Fivetran, SQL, etc.).
Deep familiarity with HR systems and/or ATS platforms (HiBob, Ashby, Workday, Greenhouse, or similar), either as a builder or through close collaboration with People teams.
Experience designing secure systems with role-based access control and data permissioning.
Strong product instincts—you think end-to-end, ask why, and care about building products people actually use.
Excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to translate operational challenges into technical solutions.
Experience building products from scratch and taking them into production.

Bonus points if you have:
Experience at an HR technology company, Work OS platform, or identity provider,
Experience with HRIS, ATS, compensation, workforce planning tools.
Experience building AI-powered products or internal tooling.
Experience working closely with People or Operations teams.

What you'll do
In one sentence:
Build AI-powered People systems that make Lovable run better — and create products that can graduate from internal tools to customer-facing features.
Examples include:
Partner with the People team to identify, scope, and ship AI-powered internal products.
Build integrations with HR systems (HiBob, Ashby, etc.), ATS platforms, and identity providers.
Design secure systems with robust role-based permissions and access controls.
Develop predictive and diagnostic models (workforce trends, hiring capacity, retention risks, compensation dynamics).
Create canonical datasets and source-of-truth models for hiring, headcount, compensation, organizational design, and workforce planning.
Data governance — source-of-truth logic, naming conventions, ownership.
Own products end-to-end—from research and design through implementation, deployment, and iteration.
Translate operational challenges into elegant technical solutions.
Build systems that meet legal and compliance requirements for handling sensitive employee data.
Work closely with other AI Ops Engineers, sharing building blocks, patterns, and learnings across Lovable's functions.
Build AI agents, workflows, dashboards, and decision-support tools that help leaders make better decisions.

Our tech stack
We're building with tools that both humans and AI love.
Languages: TypeScript, Python, Go
AI: OpenAI, Anthropic, MCP, AI Agents
Business Systems: HiBob, Ashby, Okta
Infrastructure: Cloudflare, PostgreSQL, Temporal
We're always looking for better tools and better ways of building software.
About your application
Please submit your application in English — it's our company language.
We review every application carefully and encourage anyone excited by the role to apply, even if your background doesn't perfectly match every bullet point.

description.text:
Autocom is a high-tech company that develops advanced diagnostic equipment for vehicles. Our end customers include vehicle repair shops and inspection companies. Our Autocom products are available in most European countries, and we work with several major companies worldwide in the automotive aftermarket. Our economic growth is stable, which allows us to continue to hire new employees, and we currently have around 120 employees. Autocom is part of the Würth Group, which has over 90,000 employees globally. More information about AUTOCOM can be found at www.autocom.se.

About the role
As a Data Solutions Engineer, you will work with complex vehicle data and build reliable data flows that turn fragmented information into structured, high-quality data for our diagnostic products. You will work across the entire data flow, from ingestion and transformation to validation and delivery, with a strong focus on data quality, automation and scalable solutions.
You will play an important role in developing and maintaining the data pipelines that form the foundation of our diagnostic products. This position combines hands-on development with problem-solving and continuous improvement and you will work independently on technical solutions while collaborating closely with software developers, data developers and other teams across the organization.
Your responsibilities will include:

Designing and developing scalable ETL/ELT pipelines.


Working with data ingestion, transformation, validation and delivery.


Ensuring data quality through automated testing and monitoring.


Identifying and resolving data errors, anomalies and pipeline issues.


Automating manual and repetitive data management processes.


Contributing to data modelling and cloud-based data solutions.


Translating technical requirements and vehicle protocols into reliable and useful datasets together with software developers, data developers and other stakeholders.


#LI-DNI
What you bring
We are looking for someone with solid experience in software development, data engineering or data solutions, who is comfortable taking ownership of technical solutions from idea to implementation. You enjoy working hands-on and solving technical problems, while also being able to step back, identify opportunities for improvement and contribute your own ideas on technical solutions and ways of working.
A relevant university degree is an advantage, but your professional experience will be the most important factor.
We believe you have:

Solid experience in programming and software development, for example Python.


Experience working with data management, data transformation and/or data pipelines.


Experience working with structured data such as XML, JSON and APIs.


The ability to independently drive technical solutions and take ownership of your work.


Good Swedish and English skills, both spoken and written.


As a person, you are self-motivated, proactive and communicative. You take ownership and enjoy driving things forward, while contributing your own ideas on how technical solutions and processes can be improved. You work in a structured and quality-focused way and enjoy collaborating with people with different areas of expertise.
Application
In this recruitment process, Autocom is collaborating with Skill. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. If you have any questions about the role or the recruitment process, please contact Johan Zizala at Skill, johan.zizala@skill.se / 0721-43 93 42.

description.text:
Passionate about making ideas a reality? Join our welcoming world of tech and let your ideas soar. 
 


Your Role

We are looking for a Senior Data & AI Platform Engineer who wants to contribute to the development of modern Data & AI platforms. In this role, you will combine deep technical expertise with hands-on engineering and help build secure, scalable, and robust environments for advanced AI solutions.
 
You will be part of Software Excellence and Information Assurance (SWEIXA) within Saab Surveillance. Working closely with other experienced engineers, you will provide technical expertise in cloud-native platforms, Kubernetes, and AI infrastructure.
 
As a Senior Data & AI Platform Engineer, you will work across the entire technology lifecycle, from design and implementation to deployment, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement. You will also contribute knowledge related to AI tools, their capabilities and limitations, helping the team develop sustainable technical solutions that meet business and customer needs.
 
Key Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and enhance cloud-native Data & AI platforms


Develop platform functionality and work with Kubernetes and Kubernetes Operators


Implement, deploy, and troubleshoot solutions in complex technical environments


Work with automation, GitOps, CI/CD, and observability


Contribute technical expertise, knowledge sharing, and the continuous improvement of team practices


Explore how emerging AI technologies and tools can be utilized and integrated into our platforms


 
Travel may be required as part of this role.
 


Your Profile

We are looking for someone with solid experience in software engineering and platform development who enjoys working close to technology. You have a strong technical interest and thrive on solving complex challenges in collaboration with others.
We believe you have experience in several of the following areas:

Golang or other programming languages used for systems-level development


Kubernetes, Kubernetes Operators, and containerized environments


Cloud-native platforms, as well as DevOps, GitOps, and CI/CD practices


Linux and automation using tools such as Python or Shell scripting


Data-intensive environments and the deployment and management of AI models


 
Experience in any of the following areas is considered a merit:

AI-assisted software development or agent-based AI


Large Language Model (LLM) technologies, including prompting and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)


Test automation


Security testing


 
You hold a university degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or have gained equivalent competence through professional experience.
As a person, you are curious, solution-oriented, and capable of understanding complex technical challenges. You enjoy sharing your knowledge and collaborating with others while also being comfortable driving technical initiatives independently.
 
This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around/of security protection. For positions requiring security clearance additional obligations on citizenship may apply.
 


What You Will Be Part Of

Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.
 
Saab is a leading defense and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by its 28,000 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world.
 
Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden. It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defense capability of several nations. Read more about us here
 
If you are interested in what benefits you can take part of as an employee at Saab in Sweden, you can read more about them here

description.text:
Vill du arbeta nära avancerade tekniska system och säkerställa att komplexa produkter fungerar som de ska? Här får du en roll där integration, test och systemförståelse står i centrum, i en teknisk miljö med höga krav på kvalitet och säkerhet.
Om rollen
Som integration- och verifieringsingenjör blir du en del av ett team som arbetar med integration, test och verifiering av avancerade tekniska system. Rollen kombinerar praktiskt arbete nära hårdvaran med analys av testresultat och ett tydligt systemperspektiv. Du arbetar med att integrera mjukvara och hårdvara, verifiera systemets funktion i olika konfigurationer och genomföra tester på systemnivå.

Arbetet är hands-on och sker till stor del i installationsmiljö, där systemen finns fysiskt tillgängliga. Du deltar i tester, analyserar testresultat och bidrar till att säkerställa att systemet uppfyller tekniska krav. Rollen innebär nära samarbete med bland annat utvecklare, systemingenjörer och projektledare och kan även innebära medverkan vid kunddemonstrationer och tester i olika miljöer.

Du blir en del av ett engagerat team där kunskapsdelning och samarbete är viktiga delar av vardagen. Det finns goda möjligheter att bygga vidare på din tekniska kompetens och utvecklas inom integration och verifiering.

Om dig
Du drivs av att förstå hur komplexa tekniska system fungerar och trivs i gränslandet mellan mjukvara, hårdvara och funktion. Du är nyfiken och vetgirig och tycker om att sätta dig in i hur olika delar hänger ihop. Som person är du kommunikativ och trivs med att samarbeta med olika funktioner. description.text:
Är du klar med din universitetsutbildning och har ett intresse för maskininlärning och signalbehandling? Ser du ett vidare steg inom försvarsindustrin som viktig och intressant? Då kan denna möjlighet vara någonting för dig.
Om rollen
Vi söker dig som har en stark teknisk grund inom exempelvis teknisk fysik, teknisk matematik eller elektroteknik och som vill arbeta i gränslandet mellan sensorik, signalbehandling och maskininlärning.
I rollen kommer du att arbeta med att behandla och analysera sensorsignaler så att de kan användas av algoritmer för detektion, klassificering och identifikation. Det handlar om att förstå hela kedjan, från sensor och råsignal till feature extraction, modellering och output.
Rollen befinner sig i ett sammanhang där höga krav ställs på säkerhet, robusthet och tillförlitlighet, och där erfarenhet från exempelvis försvarsrelaterade IT- eller kommunikationssystem, myndighetsnära verksamhet eller andra komplexa organisationer kan ge värdefull förståelse för uppdraget. Det är också en miljö där teknisk bredd och en vilja att utvecklas uppskattas.
Du kommer att vara anställd som konsult hos oss på Infuse Talent, och jobba på plats hos vår kund i centrala Stockholm med tanken att du på sikt ges möjlighet att fortsätta din karriär hos dem.
Om kunden
Kunden är ett nordiskt företag som utvecklar tekniska lösningar till försvarsindustrin, och som befinner sig i en kraftig tillväxtfas. Inom verksamheten finns seniora specialister som kommer att kunna stötta dig i ditt arbete och goda utvecklingsmöjligheter för den som ser signalbehandling, maskininlärning och sensorik som en spännande inriktning.
Mer information om kunden kommer kunna ges längre fram i processen.
Vem är du?
Vi tror att du:
har utbildningsbakgrund inom teknisk fysik, teknisk matematik, elektroteknik eller liknande
har läst kurser inom signalbehandling och gärna arbetat med ljudanalys eller annan sensordata
har förståelse för klassisk maskininlärning, till exempel klassificering, detektion eller feature-baserade modeller
har god programmeringsförmåga i Python
kan se sambandet mellan sensor, signal, feature extraction, modell och resultat

Vi ser gärna att du är driven, samarbetsorienterad och nyfiken, med ett öppet sinnelag och förmåga att ta dig an nya frågeställningar på ett lösningsfokuserat sätt.
Vidare förutsätter tjänsten svenskt medborgarskap då arbetet kan innebära kontakt med försvarssekretess, samt även god kommunikationsförmåga på både svenska och engelska.
Om oss
Vi på Infuse Talent är specialister inom talent management med ett fokus på en sak – att hjälpa talanger i början av sin karriär att nå sina drömjobb, samtidigt som vi säkerställer att våra kunder får tillgång till nästa generations specialister och ledare inom tech.
Låter det intressant?
Skicka in din intresseanmälan redan idag! Vi går igenom ansökningarna löpande.

description.text:
Why Lovable?
Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
What this role is and what it isn’t
It is a senior are lead role with scope. You’ll run an organization that spans product, platform, and applied AI - with other managers, senior engineers, and AI agents reporting in - and you’ll be accountable for what that organization ships, how it operates, and the business outcomes it drives.
It is still close enough to the work that you can drop into a Tech Lead role on a hard problem when the situation demands it. We don’t measure leadership IC time as a percentage. We measure it as the ability to pick up the work and ship at the bar you’re asking of your team.
It isn’t a role for managers who think of themselves as engineering-adjacent. You need to be credible in code, design, and on-call - and you need to want to be.
It isn’t a role for leaders who only think about engineering. We expect you to reason end-to-end about the business - economics, product, GTM, customers - and to make calls that are best for the company, not just best for your team.

What we’re looking for
15+ years of engineering experience, including 6+ years of people management at a pre-IPO startup, scale-up or frontier tech company, and at least 2 years of managing managers. Strong IC track record before management.
You’ve run an engineering organization of 30+ with managers and senior engineers reporting in. You can speak concretely about how you structured the org, how you hired up to that scale, and what you’d do differently.
Still hands-on at the Tech Lead level: you can pick up an unfamiliar codebase, design and ship a non-trivial change, run an incident, and review code at a high bar. You haven’t let your engineering muscle atrophy.
You’ve thought hard about humans and AI agents on the same team. What humans should and shouldn’t delegate. How productivity gets measured when the unit of work is shifting. Strong opinions, lightly held.
Comfortable navigating ambiguity and driving clarity at an organisational level, not just technically. You write the doc that aligns three teams instead of waiting for someone else to.
Deep technical credibility in at least one area - full-stack product (React/TypeScript + Go/Rust), platform and developer experience (Kubernetes, sandboxing, observability, CI/CD, application frameworks), or applied AI (training, evals, agent systems, model serving).
Cross-functional to your core and business-fluent: you work seamlessly across design, product, and go-to-market, and know how to bring people along with you; andable to reason end-to-end about unit economics, product strategy, GTM, and customer outcomes
Track record of building and growing teams: you’ve hired senior engineers others wanted to work with, grown managers under you who became great in their own right, and set up career growth and performance practices that didn’t require constant maintenance. People follow you between companies.
Based in Stockholm or London or ready to relocate — this is an on-site, 5-days-a-week role.

What you’ll do
In one sentence: Run the engineering organization that builds Lovable - humans and agents both - and stay close enough to the work to be the senior engineer in the room when it matters.
Lead engineering. Product, platform, and applied AI under one roof. Own the roadmap and the business outcomes the org is on the hook for.
Set technical direction across the org: drive the design docs and architectural decisions that span teams, push back hard on weak plans (including your own), and hold a high bar for what ships.
Shape engineering culture: how we ship, how we write code, how we hire, how we deploy agents. Set norms that outlast any single project.
Ship fast: at Lovable the question is always “how fast can we get this to users?” You bias toward production and pull research, prototypes, and experiments into reality on the order of days and weeks, not quarters.
Build the operating model for an engineering org where humans and AI agents work side by side. We’re inventing this in public, and you’ll set the patterns the rest of the company learns from.
Operate as a peer to the executive team. Own outcomes that span beyond engineering, make the company’s biggest calls alongside the rest of leadership, and translate them back into engineering work that matters.

Our tech stack
We’re building with tools that both humans and AI love:
Frontend: React, TypeScript
Backend: Go and Rust
Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, many LLM providers
Data: ClickHouse, Firestore, Spanner, BigQuery
DevOps & tooling: Kubernetes, gVisor-based sandboxing for agentic workloads, GitHub Actions, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Terraform
Local tooling: Nix, DevEnv

About your application
Please submit your application in English — it’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.
We treat all candidates equally — if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

 Ready to join us?
Help us unlock human creativity and build the future of software creation.

description.text:
Build AI that works in the real world
We are looking for an AI Solutions Engineer who wants to build AI solutions that work inside client environments, pass their security reviews and keep running after the project closes. This is not about prototypes or pilots. It is about getting solutions into production, connected to the systems clients actually use.
The role
You will work alongside our AI engineers and transformation strategists to design, build and deploy agentic solutions for clients. You will handle everything from technical design and integrations to cloud deployment and client-facing conversations about what you have built.
A central part of the role is contributing to reusable architectures and standards so that each new engagement builds on the last rather than starting from scratch. The role spans infrastructure, integrations and technical design. You may not be equally strong in all three, and we are not expecting that. We are looking for range and the appetite to keep widening it.

Contribute to the technical design of AI solutions, including agent architecture, tool selection and orchestration, and integration logic


Build and maintain integrations into client systems, including REST APIs, gateways and connections into marketing and communications technology platforms


Set up and operate solutions on Azure or AWS, covering deployment, monitoring, access control and cost management


Take part in client meetings, turning requirements into technical options and explaining what has been built to non-technical stakeholders


Contribute to reusable architectures and components that carry over to the next client


Ensure that security and data governance requirements are addressed throughout the build process


What good looks like after 6 months

Solutions you have worked on are running in client environments and can be maintained by more than one person


The client's IT and security teams are comfortable working with you directly


Integration work you have contributed to is being reused across clients


Colleagues actively want you on their engagements


Who you are
You are someone who is motivated by getting things to work in practice, not just in theory. You have a few years of experience working in tech and are comfortable being the only technical person in a room, explaining trade-offs without jargon and being honest about what will and will not work. You are curious, you ask when you do not know, and you document what you build so others can maintain it.
To succeed in this role you bring a combination of the following experience and strengths:

Experience shipping production code, including working in unfamiliar codebases


Hands-on experience with Azure or AWS, including setting up and managing infrastructure in production


Integration experience including REST APIs, authentication and webhooks


Experience building solutions powered by LLMs (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic), with practical understanding of how agents behave with real data


Working knowledge of security and data protection principles (e.g. least privilege, data residency), with the ability to identify when specialist support is needed


Professional English. Swedish is an advantage but not required


Nice to have

Experience from an agency or consultancy environment


Familiarity with marketing and communications technology platforms


Experience with Node.js and/or Python


Working at Comprend
Comprend is a place of belonging, where people are valued and empowered to create impact. We embrace diverse perspectives, bridge gaps, dare to challenge and win as a team. This is a full-time position. We prefer you to be based in Stockholm, Helsingborg or Malmö, where most of the team is located, but are open to discuss placement in London or Helsinki as well. We offer a competitive employment package.
About Comprend
Comprend is a partner for tech-enabled marketing and communication driving transformative impact. We are 200 specialists collaborating across Sweden, Finland and the UK. With extensive expertise and a strong track record in B2B, B2C and corporate communication, we help clients decode complexity, influence audiences and strengthen brand perception. With us, your voice will be one of many diverse and highly valued perspectives that shape how we work and partner with our clients. Comprend is part of Aura, a leading consultancy group with over 500 specialists across a wide mix of backgrounds and expertise.

To succeed in this role you bring a combination of the following experience and strengths:

  • Experience shipping production code, including working in unfamiliar codebases

  • Hands-on experience with Azure or AWS, including setting up and managing infrastructure in production

  • Integration experience including REST APIs, authentication and webhooks

  • Experience building solutions powered by LLMs (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic), with practical understanding of how agents behave with real data

  • Working knowledge of security and data protection principles (e.g. least privilege, data residency), with the ability to identify when specialist support is needed

  • Professional English. Swedish is an advantage but not required

Nice to have

  • Experience from an agency or consultancy environment

  • Familiarity with marketing and communications technology platforms

  • Experience with Node.js and/or Python

Working at Comprend

Comprend is a place of belonging, where people are valued and empowered to create impact. We embrace diverse perspectives, bridge gaps, dare to challenge and win as a team. This is a full-time position. We prefer you to be based in Stockholm, Helsingborg or Malmö, where most of the team is located, but are open to discuss placement in London or Helsinki as well. We offer a competitive employment package.

About Comprend

Comprend is a partner for tech-enabled marketing and communication driving transformative impact. We are 200 specialists collaborating across Sweden, Finland and the UK. With extensive expertise and a strong track record in B2B, B2C and corporate communication, we help clients decode complexity, influence audiences and strengthen brand perception. With us, your voice will be one of many diverse and highly valued perspectives that shape how we work and partner with our clients. Comprend is part of Aura, a leading consultancy group with over 500 specialists across a wide mix of backgrounds and expertise.

Your New Role 
We are looking for a structured and detail-oriented Data Administrator to support a large-scale industrial operation in Luleå. In this key onsite role, you will ensure that operational and sampling data is accurate, traceable, and readily available to support daily decision-making and continuous improvement.
As Data Administrator, you will act as a central hub for data collection, validation, and reporting. Your main tasks will include:

Maintaining and reconciling daily operational logs and measurement records


Updating and managing Excel-based data trackers and reports


Monitoring and maintaining equipment and device tracking records


Collaborating closely with sampling and field teams to verify data and resolve discrepancies


Reviewing incoming measurement results and ensuring data quality


Preparing structured reports and shift handovers for operational teams


Supporting audits, quality reviews, and traceability requirements


Contributing to process improvements and data automation initiatives


This is an opportunity to become part of a collaborative and growth-oriented environment where your work directly contributes to operational excellence. You will work closely with specialists across operations, quality, and technology while helping drive improvements in data management and reporting processes.
Company Presentation
Our client is a global industrial company and a leading provider of advanced and high-strength steel solutions. With operations in more than 50 countries, the company is driving the transition toward a more sustainable future through innovative products and a clear ambition to reduce the climate impact of steel production.
Good to Know
Scope of employment: Full-time, 100% Type of contract: Fixed-term employment as a consultant via JobBusters. Start date: As soon as possible End date: TBD In your application: Please ensure that your CV clearly demonstrates how you meet the qualifications required by the client.

Experience in data administration, data entry, or similar operational support roles


Advanced Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, and structured data management


Experience working closely with onsite operational, technical, or field-based teams


Meritorious: Experience within industrial, laboratory, or sampling environments


Meritorious: Knowledge of health, safety, and environmental (HSE) processes


Meritorious: Experience with audits, reporting systems, or data quality frameworks


Meritorious: Familiarity with Power Query, macros, or basic process automation

What we Offer
Secure employment with a collective bargaining agreement, insurance coverage and occupational pension


Wellness allowance and employee discounts and offers via Benifex (e.g., health, leisure, transport and healthcare)


Flex pension and access to the Lifeplan pension advisory service


Additional compensation during parental leave


Occupational health services


Long-term assignments and a dedicated Consultant Manager for personal support


Opportunities to build valuable experience, expand your network and grow your future career

We look forward to receiving your application 
We review applications on an ongoing basis. As recruitment processes in the consulting industry can move quickly, the position may be filled before the advertised deadline — so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
You do not need to submit a cover letter. Instead, please respond to the screening questions included in the application process.

31132504.headline: Data Stewards inom finansiella instrument till Swedbank

description.text:
Brinner du för att förstå mekanismerna bakom finansiella instrument samtidigt som du har en naturlig fallenhet för hur data struktureras, flödar och kontrolleras? Swedbank befinner sig i en spännande expansionsfas där de nu stärker upp deras domäner för Capital Markets och finansiella instrument. Vi söker dig som vill kombinera din analytiska skärpa från studier inom exempelvis finansiell matematik eller teknisk fysik med ett genuint intresse för data management.
Om tjänsten
Du kommer att tillhöra teamet Market Data, en del av Capital Optimisation, där de arbetar nära trading och riskhantering för att stärka bankens datafundament. Som Data Steward får du en nyckelroll i att strukturera och styra teamets finansiella data för att möjliggöra bättre beslutsfattande och automatisering i hela banken.
Du kommer att ingå i ett team på 5 personer och en konsult som ansvarar för serviceägarskap av plattformar och data-feeds.
Du erbjuds
Hos Swedbank får du uppleva personlig och professionell tillväxt genom självledarskap och kontinuerlig utveckling.
Swedbank erbjuder ett meningsfullt arbete i en öppen och samarbetsvillig kultur som uppmuntrar lagarbete.
En visstidsanställning via Academic Work med en fast månadslön. Goda möjligheter för att bli överrekryterad till Swedbank finns för rätt personer!

Arbetsuppgifter
Rollen som Domain Data Steward innebär att du strukturerar och förvaltar kritisk data inom finansiella instrument för att möjliggöra bättre beslutsfattande och effektivitet i banken.
Definiera och underhålla datadefinitioner och styrning för kritiska dataelement.  
Analysera och dokumentera dataflöden (lineage) i system som stöttar prissättning, risk och PnL.  
Fastställa och implementera datakvalitetsregler tillsammans med affären och systemägare.  
Samarbeta med Trading, Kvant-team, Finance, Risk och IT för att öka transparensen.  
Initiera arbete med stora och komplexa domäner för finansiella instrument, valutor och derivat.  
Bidra till implementeringen av dataprodukter som möjliggör avancerad analys och automatisering.

Vi söker dig som
Universitetsexamen inom finans, data science, datavetenskap eller ekonomi.
Grundläggande förståelse för datastyrning och datahantering.
God förståelse för finansiella instrument såsom obligationer, aktier, valutor och derivat.
Stark analytisk förmåga och intresse för komplexa datastrukturer.
Förmåga att kommunicera obehindrat på svenska och engelska.
God kunskap i SQL, dataanalys och datamodellering.

Det är meriterande om du har
Kurser inom finansiell matematik.
Erfarenhet av att arbeta med datastyrning eller datakvalitetskrav.
Kunskap om plattformar som Databricks, Snowflake eller specifika tradingsystem som Calypso.

För att lyckas i rollen har du följande personliga egenskaper:
Förändringsbenägen
Målmedveten
Social
Ordningsam
Ansvarstagande
Intellektuellt nyfiken

Vår rekryteringsprocess
Denna rekryteringsprocess hanteras av Academic Work och vår kunds önskemål är att alla frågor rörande tjänsten skickas till Academic Work.
Vi tillämpar löpande urval och kommer plocka ner annonsen när tillräckligt många kandidater har nått slutskedet i rekryteringsprocessen. Vid ansökan efterfrågas ett CV. Personligt brev använder vi inte som urvalsmetod och behöver därför inte bifogas. Rekryteringsprocessen innehåller två urvalstest: ett personlighetstest och ett test i kognitiv förmåga. Testerna är ett verktyg för att kunna hitta den kandidat med högst potential för tjänsten samt främja jämlikhet, mångfald och en rättvis rekryteringsprocess.
